121000.description:
Sano, who can't seem to connect with anyone at all - not his family, not his coworkers - turns to SNS instead. One day, he decides to finally meet up with one of his mutual followers, "S." His Internet friend turns out to be Narumi, a handsome young actor whose popularity recently shot through the roof! Although Narumi's behavior seems to hint at something bubbling beneath the surface, Sano can't shake off the feeling that he's probably being toyed around with... An emotional, heart-piercing BL between a handsome actor and a salaryman who doesn't do communication.

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Man on the Other Side

121001.description:
Why won't you try for an ending with me? One tiny freakout brings best friends Aoi and Ritsuki smack dab into the middle of the world of a dating sim. All this time, Aoi has been trying to act like a cool guy who doesn't care about love, but now that his cover is blown, is this his chance to complete a romance route just for him? And why is Ritsuki's affection meter looking like that?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Koisuru Billionaire Kinryuuin Seira no Kareinaru Unmei Sousa

121004.description:
When Master spoke about his former disciple Ittetsu, he always praised his great talent. But when Yamato comes to Ittetsu's village to bring him back to the Tenroku Monastery, he's met with a monk who sleeps in, doesn't read Sutra, can't keep quiet during Zazen, and... drinks ALCOHOL?! Just what kind of trick has been played on Yamato?! Where is the talented Buddhist monk Master speaks so highly of, and who is this fake Ittetsu in front of him? That's it. Yamato has had enough and decides he must whip Ittestu into shape during their journey together. Maybe he used to be a great monk, but surely he has since been corrupted by wickedness! Will Yamato be able to tame the carefree monk? Just what about him makes Master think he is so great?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ガールナックルガール
男装騎士の憂鬱な任務
title.romaji: Dansou Kishi no Yuuutsu na Ninmu

121008.description:
Zenya Kitataka is a college student who grew up surrounded by animals (fluffiness). He hasn't been able to touch anything fluffy since he started living alone and spends his days feeling frustrated. One day, he encounters Takeru Nekoya on campus, who has cat ears coming out of his head. Was it perhaps a hallucination caused by the lack of fluffiness in his life...? When he gives in to the temptation and touches the cat ears, Takeru blushes and pushes him down!! He finds himself unable to stop because the rich deep kisses and feelings of ecstasy are just so good...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Will a Guy Who Likes Cats Fall in Love with a Guy with Cat Eyes?
title.native: 猫好き男子はネコ目オトコと恋に落ちるのか?
title.romaji: Nekosukidanshi wa Nekomeotoko to Koi ni Ochirunoka?

121009.description: Yonemura, a supervisor of a convenient store, and his boyfriend Ando, a cheeky part-timer who’s over ten years younger, are not in an intimate relationship yet. But soon, Ando will celebrate his 20th birthday, so Yonemura is secretly planning something. Due to Yonemura's busy schedule, they can barely see each other. Then enter Mitsuhara, a new part-timer who can't seem to control his hands around Yonemura. Problems start to rise between the three!

title.romaji: SV, Koi no Shinchoku ni Tsuite.

121012.description:
Brain Damage collects four new short manga stories, a tantalizing blend of the hilarious and the macabre. In “Labyrinth Quartet,” four identical young women trapped in an eerie building must solve the mystery of why they’ve been gathered there — while being hunted by a knife-wielding stalker. In “Curse Room,” a plucky health aide is tasked with keeping zombies peaceful, lest they go on a brain-eating rampage. In “Family Portrait,” people throughout town are strangely disappearing without a trace, and the key to it all is a senile and perverted old man. Finally, in “Blood Harvest” a series of gruesomely mangled bodies are found in pristine cars — and it appears something sinister lurks within these masses of glass and steel.

(Source: Fantagraphics)

2) Noroi no Heya (呪いの部屋)
3) Kazoku no Shouzou (家族の肖像)

121014.description:
A high school student detective, Kuroshiki Jun helped the arrest, the murderous demon Yuki Ogawara escaped. The real tragedy that happened on a night of thunderstorms is not that the murderer killed all the people in the house, but also that the beloved girl Kanae was attacked by Jun's brother ── the worst monster was born It was. The psychological suspense unfolded by the extraordinary genius and the police begins!

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

121015.description: A comedic 4-koma spin-off series for Steins;Gate.

title.native: しゅたいんず・げーと！

121016.description: A manga adaptation of the fandisc STEINS;GATE: Hiyoku Renri no Darling (STEINS;GATE: My Darling's Embrace).

121017.description:
Red is just a normal kid living in the rural Pallet Town, when he decides to go out on his own adventure, along with his rival since childhood, Green. In this world of Pokemon, he makes many friends, humans and Pokemon alike. However, all is not well. Team Rocket is trying to capture Mew, a very rare Pokemon, and is performing experiments on other Pokemon, trying to increase their power. Red and his friends must battle against Team Rocket to stop their cruel experiments and unlock the secrets of Pokemon.

This entry is exclusively for the first part of the Pocket Monsters Special manga.

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL 赤・緑・青
title.romaji: Pocket Monsters SPECIAL: Red, Green & Blue

121018.description:
The handsome dog who's attached to only me.

Every Wednesday, there's a man in an animal costume who hands out balloons to kids in the park. The man also hands a balloon to a university student, Shimaki Yuudai, who is on his way to his part time job. Shimaki, while feeling inconvenienced, was unable to refuse. One day, however, he finds the words "I like you" written on a piece of paper attached to the balloon...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Kigurumi-kun began as a web comic on the author's Twitter account on April 9, 2016. The series was published in book format with extras by Ichijinsha on February 15, 2018.

121019.description: Meet Ishida Yumi, a 16-year old high schooler who was born with the ability to teleport. The only problem is, she can't control her ability at all! Without knowing when it'll happen next, or where she'll be sent, Yumi is suddenly teleported into a variety of places and scenarios!

title.native: FLY とんでもテレポートガールユミ

121022.description:
After many years, Udou Takayuki has finally fulfilled his desperate unrequited love and began a relationship with Seiji Kiyotake. Now as a working member of society his only goal is to protect this love. However, when Udou visits Kiyotake's parents' house he witnesses the reality of what stands in the way of their love. What future will they choose?

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Contains the Gosan no Heart story "Gosan no Katachi" (誤算のカタチ) and an extra chapter.
synonyms: How to Stop the Never Ending Unhappiness

title.native: やまない不幸の終わらせ方

121023.description:
This chapter features the journeys of Yellow through Kanto trying to find Red after a beaten-up Pikachu (Red's) ends up at the doorstep at Oak's Lab. In the meantime of finding Red, Yellow gets attacked by the members of the Elite Four and their quest to make an all-Pokémon world.

(Source: Bulbapedia)

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL イエロー

121025.description:
Yuu, a delivery male escort, has a crush on his gentlemanly and sadistic customer - Mr. Saitou. But one night after embracing him, Saitou asks Yuu to move in with him?! Yuu is thrilled with the sudden development, but Saitou seems to have a hidden and mysterious side to him. Are his motives driven by love or is it just pure lust? Or...

Note: Chapter 5 (Room.0) was previously released as a one-shot in the Immoral Sex (インモラル・セックス) anthology.

title.native: プライベート・リビドー

121027.description:
Wannabe adventurer Istolfa dreams of becoming a first-class adventurer and earns a small amount of money by collecting herbs, but no matter what he does, he is unable to escape from life on the streets. One day he runs into the light elf Stella, who...gives him one single gold coin?! No tricks! No reincarnation! This is the beginning of a traditional fantasy story where a normal boy challenges a dungeon to fulfill his dreams!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Chicchakute Kawaii Senpai ga Daisuki nanode 1-nichi 3-kai Teresasetai

121029.description:
"When I’m grown up, will you marry me?"
Eta, a feline beast person, always remembered their promise, but Souta grew up and seemed to have forgotten everything when he became a high school student.

Contains three stories:
• Let's Get Married! -Childhood Friend is a Cat-
• I Like Otori-san!
• My First Experience with Ushi-kun

title.native: 結婚しようよ! ~幼馴染はネコ科獣人~
title.romaji: Kekkon Shiyou yo! Osananajimi wa Nekoka Juujin

121030.description:
The possession that happens to others befell on me too. I’m pretty sure that I’m a supporting character… But what on earth is this novel? On top of being a widow with stepdaughters of my age, I’m living a cursed life in which I transform into a black swan every night because of black magic! I need to suppress my tears and change my fate… Not. Why should I? Why so serious? A duchess by daytime, and a carefree queen of the lake by nighttime. Bravo, my destiny! Life should be spontaneous! As much as I wished to continue living like this, I chanced upon a white baby swan.

“Mommy, awe you weally my mommy?”

What, you’re a human? And the tyrant emperor’s youngest sister moreover?

“I’m not your mommy! Can’t you tell from the colour of our feathers?”

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why’s she so freaking adorable?! As we endure the obsession and persecution(?) of her seven older brothers, including the tyrant emperor, can our mother-daughter love ever be fulfilled?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess

121031.description:
One day, I opened my eyes and found myself in... prison?!

That's right. Out of all the characters I could've reincarnated into, I woke up inside a 19+ rated romance novel as the villain's younger sister. To make things even worse, I was locked up inside the infamous Kambrakam Prison for my brother's crimes.

Deep within the very same prison lies Henrich Doran von Hel, who's rumored to be suffering from a curse that turns him into a beast. In the original novel, he's supposed to meet the female lead and spend an interesting night with her here in prison... but of course, the plot's gone awry thanks to my existence. What kind of future lies in store for me now that I've gotten myself tangled up between the novel's greatest villain and its male lead?!

(Source: Kakao, translated)
synonyms: I Met the Male Lead in Prison

121054.description:
This chapter features the journeys of Gold through Johto trying to at first search for the ones who stole his backpack and uncovers that the ones who stole his backpack are planning something. Two other new Trainers come into the plot of the story, Silver, whose life is tied in with the villains of this series, and Crystal, an average Pokémon Trainer with a staggering talent in catching Pokémon who later helps Professor Oak catch all the Pokémon to complete his Pokédex. Along with these three, the original 3 Pokédex holders come back to help these three along with Yellow. With their aid, will Gold be able to stop the reformed Team Rocket and the Masked Man's nefarious schemes?

(Source: Bulbapedia)

title.native: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL 金・銀・クリスタル
title.romaji: Pocket Monsters SPECIAL: Gold, Silver & Crystal

121055.description:
Young actor Takeru tries to keep contact with Kurama, his underclassman from college, but his timing is so bad that he's basically stalking him. When popular TV personality Choko warns him to stay away from Kurama, Takeru turns defiant, only for Choko to drag him out to drink and force his intentions out of him. Seeing Takeru drunk, vulnerable, and truthful makes Choko recognize how cute he is! This is a guy who could quiet any crying child, but somehow, his cute side is a knockout! Prepare for Choko to go from lady mode to super-hot man! The highly requested spinoff of "Careless Romance" is here at last!!! Includes a 4-page bonus chapter exclusive to the e-book edition.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes Chapter 8 of Renai Fuyuki Todoki and one extra chapter.

synonyms: That Time Gon Nakayama Got Reincarnated in the world of Shoot!

title.native: シュート！の世界にゴン中山が転生してしまった件
title.romaji: Shoot! no Sekai ni Gon Nakayama ga Tensei Shite Shimatta Ken

121058.description:
Momoichi Kuroda just wants to become stronger. He may have won all the fistfights he's ever fought, but he just can't help but think there's a way to be even stronger than this. When he sees his classmate Shirato in a compromising position, he gets to witness his deepest, darkest secret - and the rare kind of "strength" Kuroda could only dream of having. So the question now is, will Shirato turn him into a vampire already!?

(Source: futekiya)

Chapter count includes an extra and a one shot

title.native: バンパイアいただきます

121059.description: The time is the Sengoku era when you won't know tomorrow. There was a baby boy abandoned in a temple. The baby named “Kei” was just like a boy, but was certainly “nobody”. It was very slowly growing as if it were living at a different time from the flow of human life. To go out of the temple, I had lost my purpose of living just to wait in this temple for the immature body to decay.

121060.description:
Fashion student Subaru is on the hunt for a model for his next show when he happens upon an unfashionable young man on the train whose raw assets showed a lot of promise!! As he's praying for the chance to see him again, the unfashionable guy from before, Kazue, shows up at his part-time job!? As his friend, Subaru teaches Kazue how to up his style game, and is blown away by the final result. "I knew he had a nice face..." Kazue agrees to be his model, but on one condition: "I'll be your model if you go out with me"! Subaru really needs a model, so he agrees to date him without a second thought. But when he does, the now stunning Kazue forcibly puts his tongue in Subaru's mouth...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Koibito desu ken!: Oogata Ken wa te ga Hayai

121067.description: Monica's first witch execution awakens something in her. Without understanding how or why, she rescues the witch and flees the city with her, leaving behind everything she's ever known. She arrives at the witch's guild along with the witch, Gloria. This is where their journey begins.

title.native: ウィッチギルド ファンタジア

121070.description: Extra doujin for Kokoro wo Korosu Houhou.

121073.description:
The first day they met was on the train. While Akiha Konno was on his way to his first day of school in Tokyo, some creep just had to touch his butt...Thankfully, the nice college guy saved him, but, uhhh...Akiha really didn’t mean to just glomp him like that! Worse, he called the fox ears that appear when he’s all worked up “cute”! Welp, it’s not like he’ll ever see him again...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: かわいくない、うそとヒミツ
君だけのラブモンスター
愛されたって脱ぎません。～パンツ限界チャレンジ編～

121086.description:
The Haruna family is famous for being poor, with eight siblings, including the youngest sister, Ran, and seven older brothers who love their younger sister. The daily dinner table is a little lonely with only a few side dishes, but the older brothers do their best to make sure that Ran is their "top priority"!! Everyone is friendly, and every day is lively.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Haruna Nana: Her 7 brothers of the Haruna Family

121088.description:
Mine-kun is Asexual. He doesn't like sexual intimacy in a relationship. He can kiss a girl, but it's not something he wants to do if he can help it. But Murai loves him so much that she's willing to overlook the fact that she can't hold his hand; that she can't cuddle up next to him when they watch movies together; that she can't fall in love with him the way that she hopes to be loved in return. In the eyes of those around them, is this even a relationship that's meant to last, or is it a train wreck just waiting to happen?

(Source: Irodori Lite)

title.native: 峰くんはノンセクシャル

121090.description:
Professor Saikawa and Nishinosono Moe go to camp on an island where the mysterious Professor Magata Shiki has a closed laboratory. They're curious about the murder of Magata's parents, and they manage to talk their way into the lab itself. While they are inside, a dressed-up corpse is shockingly propelled out of the door of Magata's quarters! It appears she was murdered, and she won't be the last...

(Source: MangaHelpers)

121091.description:
A side story of Claymore not included in the volume release.

During the Initial Male Era of Claymore warriors, Isley, Rigaldo, and Dauf meet on Vinci Hill.

121092.description: Spoonman, Rain, and Sunny - three people with unspeakable pasts. This hardboiled story chronicles their journey South for their various goals.

Light novel adaptations of specific anime-canon arcs in the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations anime.

121095.description:
A testicular cancer diagnosis at age 35 rips through Kazuyoshi Takeda's life but also brings unexpected love, friendship, and the courage to tell his story. Treatment pulls him into long hospital days, yet he still notices the moments that keep him going—the kindness of nurses, the quirks of his roommates, and the bond he forms with a fellow patient who understands his fear. As his illness worsens, the people in his life show up with a tenderness he never expected. Their care pushes him back to the manga he has dreamed of finishing, giving him a reason to keep cheery even on the hardest days.

(Source: Kana)

121096.description:
Story about a boy with mysterious powers who transfers from school to school, fighting various monsters.

2. Kurayami ni Hisomu Kiba (暗闇にひそむ牙)
3. Mononoke Dai Tokkun (もののけ大特訓)
4. Jigoku no Suna: Akuma ga Yoru Kuru (地獄の砂（悪魔が夜来る）)

title.native: 僕らはイタい生き物だ。

121098.description:
The story follows Oruka, who is wallowing in despair after he fails his college entrance exams. Desperate, he has a one-night stand with a beautiful girl named Noa after meeting her for the first time. When Oruka finally gets to college, he finds himself reunited with Noa, but she has certain conditions if they are going to continue as lovers.

(Source: Anime News Network)

121099.description: Relaxing time of 4 girls in the Plant Hobby Club.

121101.description: Men that work as a furniture for women - seats, beds, toilet covers, punching bags.

title.native: ネコじまにゃんだフル

121105.description: Story about 2 high school boys, Suzuki Taira (cheerful idiot) and Satou Tomoharu (smart and cool). When they learn that their school will be shut down at the end of the school year, they decide to become "wish granters" and help other students solve their problems so that everyone will have a fun last year and leave the school without any regrets.

121106.description: Desperately in need to kick start her career amid an unforgiving job market, Osanai Sakura made it through two levels of interviews with the Hiiragi Group, a well established real estate company, and lands a probationary position in the secretarial department. She was taken aback by her rather awkward interview session with Hiiragi Sousuke, the current president of Hiiragi Group. Meanwhile, Sakura gives her sister the push to elope with the man she likes instead of being married off against her will. She is surprised to find out that her sister's fiancee is none other than her new company's president, Hiiragi Sousuke!

121107.description:
The story takes place in 2018 Tokyo. The city is one day attacked and invaded by "Errors", humans who have gone mad and kill citizens. To exterminate these Errors, the selected boys and girls are trained to become soldiers called MT (Mistilteinn). The manga is a stylish blood-action story about the young soldiers' tragic battles. Mahiro Tokura, who has been quarantined and trained to become an Error-killing soldier, meets other young soldiers who have also gone through training.

(Source: Manga Tokyo)

121108.description:
The story follows Iku Fukuda, who likes working with kids, so he gets a job at a day care center. When he realizes there's a gap between his expectations and reality, he quits after 2 months. But Fukuda doesn't give up on his love of working with kids.

Included one-shot:
Volume 6: Hoiku no Tamago

121109.description:
This is a "constitution" biased world── One day, people with special constitutions began emerging from within humanity. By this, we include people with vampire and werewolf traits. And with the flow of time, these gradually became the norm and people with special constitutions grew to take up ninety percent of the population. But as society became brimmed with these types of people, the bias towards them grew. Those with a particularly strong constitutions now live out their lives in academic cities provided by the government. When Kazuyoshi, someone with absolutely no special trait, in other words, someone with "Zero Constitution" steps foot in one of these cities, he comes upon a seemingly suspicious and special constitutioner...

(Source: Official site)

121110.description:
Despite being born as the daughter of a nanny, I considered myself blessed. With my loving mother, caring masters, and their three children, I couldn’t have asked for a better life.

However, this all changed during the year my mother and masters died of a plague. That was when I remembered who I was before this life.

Somehow, I was reincarnated as a side character of an angsty reverse harem romance novel. The problem was that I was the final boss in this novel, the queen of snakes who uses the young masters, the future main villains, to send the Empire to ruin.

I knew what I wanted to protect, at all costs.

121111.description: Law D. Eldric is traveling on a ship, when it gets seized by a group of pirates led by the beautiful Anrietta Simons, also known as the "Emerald Queen." Law manages to escape, but the wheels of a fate and romance have been put into motion...

121112.description: Story about a young aspiring judoka set during the Meiji period.

121325.description:
As if being reincarnated in the slums wasn't bad enough, I became the test subject of a cruel experiment in a crime-plagued city.

One day, a man destroyed the research facility I was in, and upon recognizing him, I discovered I was in the world of a hopeless reverse harem novel. After I escaped from the research facility, I was living a normal life--until I moved in right next to the female lead’s house. I realized I’d become an extra from the novel, as well as the female lead’s neighbor!

If everything goes according to plan, the female lead would save the villain, who fainted after being fatally injured, and would become the subject of his fanatical obsession. But why is the sub male lead villain here, unconscious in front of my house? Lakius Avalon was the king of the dark world, as well as the fearsome man I'd met at the research facility.

I looked around quickly, then shoved his body with my foot. "You've come to the wrong house, villain."

So when the infamous cold-blooded Duke Tesar Ardielle asks for her hand in marriage, Senia agrees, if only to leave behind her suffocating life (and to stop Tesar from crying all the time)! Unbeknownst to Senia, she and Tesar shared a life in the past, and the two have been reincarnated over and over again, although each time has ended tragically. In this new timeline, can Tesar truly prevent Senia's doomed destiny, once and for all?

Honestly, at this rate, I should just become the next emperor. I’ll conquer the entire continent and attain my sweet revenge on Lacuz. And so, I turned to evil and wicked ways, as befitting my role as a witch. I even won over the princes with my overwhelming strength. So I thought that everyone would fear me, but…

I remember the story of a novel I had read in my previous life just before my marriage. If you don’t mess up the wedding, you’ll be poisoned by your husband! So I just kissed the pastor who was in charge of the ceremony.

"Commander, are you alright?"

One of the holy knights shouted as he approached the pastor who was kissed.

"Huh, what?"
"Wait... are you the commander of the Holy Knights?"

****

Rurutia, who was about to die, wanted to spend her last moment in a temple where she felt at ease the most. She started a business with her friends for the temple, and it was a big hit.

"Miss, you have the world in the palm of your hands!"
"Are you a God who descended to earth?"

In the midst of being embarrassed by the large crown, the commander of the holy knights himself was also acting strange.

“All I wish for is to be your husband.”, he said that with eyes shining with obsession.
"Take responsibility for stealing my first kiss."

This is all so wrong. It seems that I changed my future.

During the first time she lived her life, she lived in a strict knight's household, but when the real "Child of Fate" appeared, she was sacrificed as a scapegoat for them. During the second time, she was abused by an outwardly respectable scholar; the third time, she ran away and lived as a beggar. Since the country seems to not be safe for her, she decided to leave it this time. To that end she chose …a family of the biggest and coldest villains in the kingdom. She just tried to get along with them for the time being, but her family has turned out to be absurdly overprotective and doting?!

Unfortunately for the guy, his luck goes from bad to worse when the only round in the gun ends up in his head. Leo immediately cuffs himself to the bed and calls the police to come and arrest him. Fast forward 4 years, and Leo is released from prison where he is greeted by his former police supervisor, Zenhachirou Otsuka. Otsuka tells Leo that he too has left the force and has started up his own private investigation company and that he wants Leo to join him. With little idea of what do with his newly found freedom, Leo agrees to join Otsuka’s company and starts work the very same day.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Heat&Run～お前のフェロモンに溺れたい～

121379.description:
Tateo Sone runs a pharmacy in Odawara and leads an ordinary but happy life with his beautiful wife and daughter-in-law. One day, however, when his wife tells him she is pregnant, he is shocked. It's because he has a secret: he has never had a functioning lower half of his body. His wife's child is not his own...Tateo despairs at the thought. At that time, a man named Sumaoka happens to give him a mysterious ED drug. Tateo impulsively takes the drug and is shocked to find that the function of his lower body miraculously recovers. Tateo declares to Sumaoka that he will recreate and make this medicine himself. But this is the beginning of a dangerous day that will change his life forever!

(Source: Big Comic, translated)
synonyms: ジャンボマックス ～ハイパーED薬密造人～

title.native: JUMBO MAX ～ハイパーED薬密造人～

121380.description:
"While the world still exists, you must reveal your feelings to your loved one."

Shino can't stop thinking about the words of the fortune-teller. Her thoughts stray to the sister of her boss, the woman that she shares a room with.

(Source: Amazon, translated)

title.native: 世界が終わるそのまえに
title.romaji: Sekai ga Owaru Sono Mae ni

121381.description:
Guitar Shop Rosie is a guitar repair shop run by Angus and Malcolm, two brothers who aren't great at making money but who love AC/DC and rock music. Guitars from all sorts of backgrounds and circumstances are brought in for repair. This series portrays the stories behind the guitars being repaired and the shop's customers.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ギターショップ・ロージー

121382.description: Shen Fan is determined to understand the inner world of the one she has secretly admired for three years. Her desperation draws her like a moth to a flame, even as she knows that her love may kill her. And what does the latter think? "This girl is very interesting, I suppose I could play with her a little."
synonyms: マイ レッド スパイダーリリー
乙女の群像 みやこかっく作品集

121385.description:
Do you want a peek into the daily life of a boys' dorm? Niyama presents: An exciting boys' school life!

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: オトナを困らせるんじゃありません！

121386.description: Come join the "Palette" illustration club where your imagination becomes reality!

121387.description: In the old and cheap boarding house, Fukujyu, Fine Arts student Haru finds himself rooming with the quietly unconventional Natsu. A shy and reserved young man, Natsu is often the butt of jokes for his classmates and teachers. When nasty rumors about Natsu's past begin circulating among their acquaintances, Haru's tepid friendship with Natsu is sure to be tested.

title.native: 六月のヘンゲンさん
あくまで君の天使になりたい
title.romaji: Akuma de Kimi no Tenshi ni Naritai

121391.description:
"I also want to save the world!"

Princess May of the Earlshide Kingdom loves talking about her beloved Shin to her friends who attends the Primary School. She wants to fight with him. The people around her find May's remarks unbelievable, but she secretly learns attack magic from Alice Corner and Lynn Hughes

One daye, May, who participated in an open-air camp hosted by the school, is abducted by a teacher who has been brainwashed by a devil...

(Source: Kenja no Mago Wiki)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

121393.description:
Yui was reincarnated into another world as a member of the noble Nuir family. But when it appears that she failed to inherit her family’s unique enchanted tailoring gifts, the young seamstress is in for a life of torment and misfortune. Will a meeting with a kind-hearted noble be enough to change her fate?

(Source: Yen Press)

121394.description:
Yui befriended the fairies she could see around her by using her magic to help mend their clothes. Disowned for her relative lack of skill in blessweaving, Yui's taken in by nobleman Rodin Calostira, and her luck begins to change...

(Source: Yen Press)

121395.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. SNOW
2. Anata wo Wasurenai (あなたを忘れない)
3. Pieta (ピエタ)
Note: Based on a short story by Jirou Asada (浅田次郎). Not included in the digital edition.
4. Niji no Machi (虹の町)
5. Guren no Ken (紅蓮の剣)

title.native: SNOW 村上もとか叙情傑作選

121396.description:
Hikaru Sudo is a doctor who treats cyborgs, AI. and humans in the year 2175. A mother rejoices at the birth of her child, a boy is believed to have been infected with a cyber virus, and a stubborn old man hates the AI that is keeping him alive in a medical unit. This book contains five superb stories of various patients.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

121397.description:
Seonyoo is a super shy, virginal college drop-out. But on social media, he's cute, popular, and friendly - the perfect idol! He has thousands and thousands of followers - including Yeonwoo, a well-polished, handsome medical student who adores cute things...especially when they cry.

Seonyoo feels out of his depth when Yeonwoo DMs him asking dirty questions, and even more so when he starts receiving commands! Can Seonyoo be a good pet and follow his lessons obediently?

121398.description:
Yoon works at an animal hospital. Eun-Woo comes every so often to the vet to get treated which gets on Yoon's nerves. In order to treat Eun-Woo's wounds, Yoon takes off his mask and is absolutely captivated by his good looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 月にハウリング〜オオカミ男と獣医さん〜
กระซิบรักใต้แสงจันทร์
The Ass I Knew Too Well

121400.description: Right after she awakens, a former wage slave becomes the villainess side character with a suspicious black reputation, a rebellious and neglectful younger brother, and a cruel and ruthless male lead! Hey! Even if the one you love is the beautiful heroine, you don't have to treat me like a tool?! Good thing I still have a handsome master who always consoles me from time to time... Back to the topic~ Observe how the wage slave protagonist crosses into another world and survives through the hurdles.

121401.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.

121402.description: Ayakashi Town" is a mysterious town where camellia girl Tsubaki has arrived. I met a wide variety of youkai at the "Youya" where I was looking for a resident clerk...! ? Tsubaki's heart is saved by living with them, who feels warmth of the heart unlike the imagination, but there is one big problem...? In addition to the title work "Welcome to Youya", you can laugh and cry and fully open the red tiles!

title.native: あやかし世界へようこそ

121403.description: Aimi and her friends want to prank the teacher, but it all goes wrong...

title.native: なんでも一つだけかなう願いに「回数を無限にして」とお願いした結果
title.romaji: Nandemo Hitotsu dake Kanau Negai ni "Kaisuu wo Mugen ni Shite" to Onegai shita Kekka

121406.description: A collection of stories about life and death.

synonyms: The Radash Village in Frontier No.7

title.native: 第七異世界のラダッシュ村

121409.description:
Yakko has always lived in the shadow of her model/actress younger sister, Yuno. So when she's surprised on her 17th birthday by super-popular actor Araki Shigaraki, she assumes he's looking for Yuno...until he declares his love for Yakko?! Not only that, he'd declared his love for her before...but now, as then, she doesn't believe him! But he's determined, and if she won't see him as a boyfriend, maybe she'll see him as a pet...?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: あらきくんは飼いならせない

121410.description:
When I woke up, I had been reborn as a baby. My mother passed away and I was neglected by my father. Even though I was born in a Marquis family, my life started on a HARD MODE. But I won’t be discouraged. I will eat well, sleep well, move much, get whatever I can get and live happily.

This is a story of a little girl with the power to create barriers involving everybody to become happy.
synonyms: Reincarnation's little girl never gives up
The Reborn Little Girl Won't Give Up
Reincarnated Little Girl Never Gives Up

title.native: 転生幼女はあきらめない

121411.description:
When I woke up, I had been reborn as a baby. My mother passed away and I was neglected by my father. Even though I was born in a Marquis family, my life started on a HARD MODE. But I won’t be discouraged. I will eat well, sleep well, move much, get whatever I can get and live happily.

This is a story of a little girl with the power to create barriers involving everybody to become happy.

121412.description:
"Let's...go back to being just friends." After dating for six months, Sakura was dumped by her childhood friend, Ren. She tries her best to move on, but when she sees her ex-boyfriend on her first day of high school, she realizes that her feelings for him still haven't faded…Maybe there is still a chance for them? After all, she still loves him.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: รักนี้ต้องทวงคืน

title.native: ハーモナイザー・エリオン

121415.description:
It all started with a plane landing at Narita Airport. A single passenger carried a mysterious virus, and before anybody knew it, this infection had become widespread! Responding to this crisis, the national government decided to blockade the borders of Chiba Prefecture. Within a town overrun by zombies, six people take refuge in a shopping mall in Makuhari. Having obtained food and safety, these survivors…hopelessly fall in love?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 生き残った6人によると
キミにもできる! 女の子一本釣りマニュアル
title.romaji: Kimi ni mo Dekiru! Onnanoko Ipponzuri Manual
Mashiba Kyoudai wa Kao ga Katai

121419.description:
This adaptation of Wataru will show new aspects of the world Soukaizan.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichikon no Ryuujinmaru

title.native: 魔神英雄伝ワタル～七魂の龍神丸～
title.romaji: Mashin Eiyuuden Wataru: Shichi Kon no Ryuujinmaru

121421.description:
Ritsuko has only been working in her first job for one year, but on some evenings she feels totally exhausted. All the sitting and the hectic pace of everyday office life stress her. One evening she discovers the poster of a yoga school. In Ms. Kiyomi's classes she soon learns how to leave the stress behind and always get fit and fresh for the next day.

(Source: Altraverse, translated and edited)

121422.description:
My friend has always dated hot girls, but his current girlfriend is my... shh! It's a secret!

(Source: Toomics)

121423.description: Chef gets transported to another world moments before he was about to die and draws the sword saint skill.
synonyms: A Cook Having the Title of the Great Swordmaster

title.native: 剣聖の称号を持つ料理人
title.romaji: Kensei no Shougou wo Motsu Ryourinin

121424.description:
Sanghwa is a shy introvert with a longtime crush on his handsome friend Ryeohan, but then again, EVERYONE likes him. Feeling like he can’t compete for Ryeohan’s affections, Sanghwa dives into The Legend of Saga, an online game where he plays as “idealize.” He befriends “thegreatmirae,” a cute healer who clearly has a soft spot for Sangwha… and who just so happens to be a real-life gangster. Could this tough guy be the ideal lover Sanghwa’s been looking for after striking out in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: พี่นักเลงที่รัก

121426.description:
Kotarou is a middle-school boy living a mundane life without dreams. His only distraction is to chat with a lively high-school girl he calls "Miss Akogi", who plays the guitar in the street. After a UFO suddenly crashes in the middle of the city, the world around them starts changing in unexpected ways. Suddenly, everything seems possible…

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: 夢見が丘ワンダーランド

121427.hashtag: #スカートをはいたおじいさん

title.native: スカートをはいたおじいさん

121428.description:
It's a wonderful day for Wataru Ito, high school student, master martial artist, honorable and humble teenager, and all-around awesome guy. During his daily run to school he happened to get hit by a large truck barreling around a corner. Not that this is the kind of event that would be the end of the likes of Wataru, of course, but when a truck runs into you, you get sent to another world. That's just the way things are sometimes. Still, Wataru's not about to take this kind of thing lying down! The first thing he sets out to do is find who's the toughest hombre in this land and go up against the greatest challenges this new world has to offer! Oh, and the greatest fighter in this place also happens to be the Demon Lord who is kidnapping people all across the kingdom in an attempt to wipe out humanity? Even better! Wataru's main interest is in facing a tough battle; saving the world in the process is just icing on the cake!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: WATARU!!! The Hot-Blooded Fighting Teen & His Epic Adventures After Stopping a Truck with His Bare Hands!!
title.native: トラック受け止め異世界転生ッ！熱血武闘派高校生ワタルッッ！！
title.romaji: Truck Uketome Isekai Tensei! Nekketsu Butouha Koukousei Wataru!!

title.native: たびたびデーモンストレーション

121434.description:
A collection of one-shots by Yumi Unita.

1-2. Koukan Housoku (こうかん法則)
3. Karakara Renka (カラカラレンカ)
4. Karakara Henka (カラカラヘンカ)
5-12. Kusamichippuri (道草っぷり, Loitering Away)
13. Kusamichippuri Sonogo (道草っぷり その後)

121435.description:
Ten years after the Great Tokyo War, each prefecture in Japan has split up into independent nations. Each nation is ruled by a prophet called "Mosa" and an army called "Mob" as they start to compete to take over other countries. Four "Mob" girls from the Saitama clan, Nozomi, Yukina, Ai, and Chiaya, are ordered by their "Mosa" to travel around Japan riding their motorcycles to mediate multiple battles between nations and clans as they emerge.

(Source: Anime News Network)

synonyms: The Rolling Girls: Inspiration x Tabibito

title.native: ろ〜りんぐ☆が〜るず インスピレーション×旅人〈トラベラー〉

121437.description: Five friends from high school return to dig up a time capsule they left years ago...

121438.description:
Owen, a detective in the crime city of Wilkins, meets Mido, a priest with prosthestic legs made of glass, at the emergency transportation site of drug addicts. Mido says that the drug addict is possessed by a "demon" and he has come to exorcise him... Is Mido for real?

A dark fantasy with an unconventional priest and a detective chasing demons and solving mysteries!

(Source: Gangan Online, translated)

Note: Includes three volume extras.

121439.description:
Xiao Yao, a young lady of a wealthy, respectable family in the 21st century, thought her life had ended when she passed away due to a deadly illness. However, she opened her eyes and found herself in the body of a manhua's villainess, Princess Abella.

Despite not having any magic powers nor capabilities, the pompous and vicious Princess caused countless people to suffer from her heinous acts. Her greed for the throne even led her to murder her own father, thus sentencing her to death while the protagonists of the manhua lived happily ever.

With a second chance at life in such a healthy body, Xiao Yao will not sit back idly while the Princess' impending doom befalls her again. This time, she will strive to change the Princess' fate, and along the way, will attempt to discover her hidden secrets and of those around her...
synonyms: The Evil Sorceress Plans to Survive!

121440.description: Kunihiko, a student at a prestigious high school who has a stomachache, helps the suffering beauty, Chisato, on his way to school. Chisato, who turns out to be a model, confesses that he has fallen for Kunihiko, but Kunihiko, who is having trouble before his exams, coldly rejects the confession. However, completely unfazed, Chisato repeatedly whispers love….!?
synonyms: Liebe schlägt mir auf den Magen

title.native: 恋する僕らは胃腸が弱い
title.romaji: Koisuru Bokura wa Ichou ga Yowai

121441.description:
Loyal king of demons said, "Now that you've found me, you need to be responsible for me." Lost memories and destined reunion. Yu Yin reincarnated twice and returned to the world he was originally from, but he got "scammed" by some unknown demon king the moment he's back. Moreover, he got bitten by him and formed an agreement! While Yu Yin was in astonishment, the demon king considered everything just normal. "I surely need to be responsible for you, given the relationship between us."

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: The Demon Lord wants to take Responsibility of Me!

title.english: My Covenant with the Monster Lord
title.romaji: Yao Zun Fei Yao Dui Wo Fu Ze

121442.description:
Do you like cats? Do you like isekai? Do you like dying horribly in an earthquake with your whole family? Then you’d fit right in with the Tanaka family! They might not have enjoyed that last part, but they’re certainly enjoying their new life in another world as the esteemed Stewart family. That’s right—the whole family reincarnated together, and they’re just as messy as they were in their first life. Kazushi (65) and Yoriko Tanaka (65) are now the esteemed Leonard (35) and Melsa (35) Stewart. Their three children, Wataru (38), Minato (35), and Heita (33) are now George (15), Emma (12), and William (9) Stewart. Come follow the Tanakas—or Stewarts—as they navigate high society with tea parties, marriage propositions, fashion design, bugs, monsters, and most importantly, giant cats!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

121443.description:
An ordinary family that loves cats. One day, the whole Tanaka family died during a major earthquake. When they woke up, they were reincarnated as the Stuart family, a noble family from another world.

Though everyone is dressed in the Western style, they have memories of their previous Japanese lives. Even though they’re confused, they’ve gotten used to living in another world.

121444.description:
Tachibana is an unsatisfied system engineer without a girlfriend.
One day, he was forcibly taken by a female boss at CLUB NAKED, a strip club where a man takes off his clothes. Among them, the number one dancer Leo caught his eye.
Tachibana falls in love with Leo's powerful dance, outfits that stimulate sympathy, and his beautiful physical body!!

121445.description:
“Let’s make a contract. You’ll be owned by me.”

“I shall serve you as if I loved you, my lady.”

An earl’s daughter and a lover of paintings, Riz, is told “Give yourself to me” by John, the temporary art gallery manager employed by her uncle. However, those words weren’t of love or romance, but because he wanted the “Holy Eyes” that could see the demons lurking in paintings which Riz had. Pressed into a contract by John, who was actually a demon, the response Riz gave was— that she was going to own a demon!?

This is a love fantasy concerning the painting of an unconventional young lady and a caustic demon!
synonyms: Miss Appraiser and the Gallery Demon

title.native: 令嬢鑑定士と画廊の悪魔
title.romaji: Reijou Kanteishi to Garou no Akuma

synonyms: The unique Rabbits are talking in my brain.
As Much as You Like About Someone

title.native: 誰かのことを好きなだけ
title.romaji: Dareka no Koto wo Suki na Dake

121448.description:
Contained one-shot: Saijoukai de Dakishimete (Embrace Me Tightly on the Highest Floor)
Fuyou loves her brother. Actually, he isn't really her brother, so can she love him?

title.native: ディープ・ブルー

121449.description:
A beautiful sad love story known as the Japanese version of "Romeo and Juliet."

Narimichi is a young man of high social standing born into the family of the shogunate. Rai, a young woman who lived freely in the mountains after she was abducted as a young child. Under normal circumstances, these two would never cross paths, but a chance encounter in front of a special tree called “Raiou” sparks an unlikely romance. The two soon fall in love, but their drastically different upbringings and the expectations of their respective families threaten to doom their relationship.

121450.description:
Korea in the 1990s. Yuna's life is going really well. She's about to graduate from college and she's dating the heir to a major company. However, one of her acquaintances, Sonhi, hates her for reasons that Yuna does not understand. Unfortunately, Sonhi's father is the head of a major bank and she uses her influence to destroy Yuna's father's company, leading directly to his suicide.

Now Yuna has to shoulder the responsibility of caring for her mother and her little brother, dropping out of school to find work and breaking up with her high-class boyfriend. However, not only is Korea in a major financial crisis, but Sonhi is further interfering to ensure that Yuna is unable to find respectable work. Yuna realizes that she must enter the night world of hostessing, in order to provide for her family.

She may be seen as a 'fallen woman,' but she will not be defeated forever! She and her family are determined that they will survive this disaster and find a new life on the other side!

121451.description: When her father dies, Kotomi decides to leave her family to become a maiko.

title.native: 魔法科高校の劣等生 よんこま編
ナイトメア・ファミリー

121455.description: The story of "Evol" begins in a village occupied by an armed group when a young girl, driven by despair, attempts suicide. She survives and wakes up, but when a man tries to drive her into a corner, a strange phenomenon occurs. The place changes, and something also happens to the boy who wakes up in the hospital after committing suicide.

title.native: よい子先生と薄い本の悪魔
title.romaji: Yoiko Sensei to Usui Hon no Akuma

121458.description:
Captain Gorou Edajima, a seasoned captain who has visited the various countries of the Special Region on a research mission, and master cook Petty Officer, 1st Class Hajime Tokushima were given a special mission: rescue an American journalist kidnapped in the Special Region! Aboard an Oyashio-class attack submarine, they set out onto the seas of the Special Region, but little did they know their mission would lead them headfirst into a whirlpool of petty rulers and pirates vying for control in the Blue Sea...

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: ゲート―SEASON2 自衛隊　彼の海にて、斯く戦えり
title.romaji: Gate Season 2: Jieitai Kano Umi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri

121460.description:
Set on an Earth where all people take the form of animals, Bell is the only girl in the world without animal characteristics. She sets out to discover if there are other beings like her. Bell wields a sword and becomes involved in the struggles between the cities and the outside world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

synonyms: キミのスキ to ボクのスキ

title.native: キミのスキtoボクのスキ
title.romaji: Kimi no Suki to Boku no Suki

title.native: 山田くんは優しすぎる
君とメリーバッドエンド

synonyms: If a National Idol Became a Younger Brother
If my ultimate idol becomes my brother and xxx.

title.native: 国民的アイドルが弟になったら
title.romaji: Kokumin Idol ga Otouto ni Nattara

121466.description:
The person who pinned down the demon female instructor was none other than the most outstanding male student in the military!?

With a high principle in discipline and both military and literacy arts, Rosilian Military Academy is the place where elite military officers are cultivated. The female instructor who works at this place that prides on its history and traditions, Lia is known by the students as the demon due to her strictness. Displeased with the indolent nature of the students nowadays, the only student she recognize with pride as a prodigy is Lewis. But that same Lewis said, "I too, have desires", and proceeds to kiss Lia, catching her off guard!!! And to end it all off he even played with her body......!!!?

"Getting pinned down by a student is outrageous but I can't go against this desire--..."

121468.description:
Tsubomi is a sophomore, and has a crush on her former teacher from her freshman year, Mr. Miyake! A hand-knitted scarf that was supposed to be a valentine’s gift, finally came together in July. She wants to gift it to him for his upcoming birthday, but unfortunately that day is a Sunday… After discovering that Fuma Yabuki from her class is actually Mr. Miyake’s cousin, she asks Fuma to put her in touch with him. However, Fuma, the school’s number one heartthrob is an unbelievably twisted guy…!? A heart-fluttering, love-hate romance story.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

121470.description: The story follows Shirоou Kasumi, a high-school student who can see the past and uses that ability to find out who murdered his mother. The sequel will again follow Shirо̄, who now attends a university.

121471.description: Let’s take a look at our young hero here, who was born and entered the world of Martial Arts. There’s nothing that he cannot do! Be it music, chess, medicine or even culinary arts. Pretending to be the weakest while he is the strongest. Women from left to right, look at how an orphan rise. An orphan who will solve numerous cases and who will become the master of the city!
synonyms: The Peak Master of the City

121472.description:
The manga artist Ganji Sumiki thinks about all kinds of things (even silly things) while running...?
Why do people run anyway?
A real road comedy in which a mangaka runs, thinks, and rambles around!

(Source: Comic Boost, translated)

121473.description:
An alcoholic dragon, a chirpy girl.

The last living dragon, Axela, lives isolated in a fort with wine as his only comfort. Meanwhile, Corette, an orphaned but optimistic girl, moves in as his caretaker and ferociously tries to get him to warm up to her. Will the two overcome their differences and bickering? What will Axela do when Corette is suddenly taken hostage by the queen?

(Source: Manta)

121474.description:
When I opened my eyes, I had become the heroine of a romance comic!

I may have become the heroine, but I prefer the second male lead!
synonyms: พระเอกของฉันคือพระรอง

121476.description:
The most important exam of his life… and Jeong-Seok blew it. Dumped by his girlfriend and rejected by his college of choice, the future looks bleak. But instead of moping, Jeong-Seok checks himself into a boarding cram school for a year. Sealed off from the outside world with nothing but a bunch of stressed-out, horny students for company, things start getting steamy in no time. How distracting! Perhaps some one-on-one lessons with the gorgeous, busty Ms. Kang will help him focus? Study hard, Jeong-Seok. Nice and hard…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: 浪人ヘブン〜滑る門には福来る〜

121480.description:
My teacher Seo-A, whom I first met at Aunt Jia and Uncle Deok-Sin's wedding. I never confessed to her, but I think she is the woman of my destiny... and now she's getting married?!

Now that I'm an adult... if I was the same age as her, would everything be different?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

121481.description:
Women exist to be conquered. And the strongest man will conquer the most women. This is how one man thinks of the world, and he has lived by this creed for years. Will his appetite be his undoing...?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

121482.description:
Estella Arthur enjoys a lazy life earning a knight's wage under the persona of her fake twin brother Austin, but when the crown prince of the Alphenstine Empire comes offering piles of gold, all the cake she can eat, and a guaranteed divorce after five years in return for her hand in marriage, even she finds it hard to say no. Now she must dodge assassinations on top of avoiding anyone learning her true identity as a woman pretending to be a man pretending to be an empress.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

121483.description: Sakurako does a lot of work at her father's small company. But her business-like attitude makes her a tough love match for marriage. When Sakurako was matched with a handsome tech CEO, he suddenly proposed marriage, but only if she agrees to his fetish: "I like to see my woman being taken by another man"! Sakurako was shaken by the proposal, but the hot kisses and caresses of his bodyguard is breaking down her will to resist...
synonyms: 今晚，社長命令我被人佔有。

title.native: 今夜、社長命令で寝取られます。

title.native: ボクの女子力はあの娘のパンツに詰まっている。
title.romaji: Boku no Joshiryoku wa Ano Ko no Pantsu ni Tsumatteiru.

121485.description:
John's wife and her best friend are up to no good... What is their secret past, and what are they trying to do with John...?

(Source: Toomics)

synonyms: A new family has been made.

title.native: あたらしい家族ができました。

121487.description:
Story about "Elf Yu" (Elf Hot Bath), a mobile hot spring bath that washes away all fatigue and dirt if an adventurer soaks in it. Yufu, the sole head of the hot spring, eagerly puts adventurers in the bath to heal them.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 警部補 ダイマジン

121489.description:
DSY Law Firm is one of the biggest in the country. But you'd be shocked at what goes on behind closed doors. Sex, corruption, blackmail, it's a madhouse in there! You'll be sucked into a modern day Sodom and Gomorrah

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: カノジョの弱みを握ったら

title.native: そのたくさんが愛のなか。
title.romaji: Sono Takusan ga Ai no Naka.

title.native: そらと箒とトマトソース
title.romaji: Sora to Houki to Tomato Sauce

121497.description:
At the scene of a terrible murder, only Toudou is able to find the surviving little girl in the closet—his niece Tsubasa. Four years later, Toudou and his father are caring for Tsubasa, who no longer speaks, and Toudou continues to work as a police detective. He's assigned to a new partner, a young woman with a promising future, Saeki. As Toudou and Saeki team up to solve murder cases together, they will also both have to confront their own painful pasts.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

title.native: ブラウンシュガァデイズ

121499.description: The Ayakashi Marriage Agency, youkai and human matchmaker!

121501.description:
Konohoshi Umika is a high-schooler who is very bad at communicating with others. Feeling almost like an alien trapped on Earth with nowhere to belong, one day she meets a girl who claims to be an actual alien!

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2021 Award in the Print Manga Category.

121502.description:
Kimura Rin is a young office worker who's constantly harassed, bullied and otherwise spends her time at work suffering. With no future ahead of her, and nothing she wants to do, she wonders why the world hurts her this way...

Until, after an incredible night with an incredible woman, she decides to become a lesbian escort.

title.native: 愛されてもいいんだよ
ボクの青春ヤングマガジン

121504.description:
A collection of short stories by Kimura Minori.

1. Warui Ko (悪い子)
2. K no Sekai (Kの世界)
3. Hare no Hi Ame no Hi Kumori no Hi (晴れの日雨の日曇りの日)
4-6. Ken, Ken, Ken Monogatari (犬・けん・ケン物語)
synonyms: Hare no Hi Ame no Hi Kumori no Hi

121505.description:
A collection of short stories by Kimura Minori.

1. Nokiko (乃己子)
2. Okaasan ga Inai (おかあさんがいない)
3. Ai-chan wo Sagashite (愛ちゃんを捜して)
4. Shinta Oboegaki (心太覚え書き)
5. Uchi no Neko wa Sekai Ichi (うちの猫は世界一)
6. Neko nan desu kedo (猫なんですけど)
7. Neko no Ki (猫の木)
8. Nora Neko Shunjuu (ノラ猫春秋)
synonyms: Uchi no Neko wa Sekai Ichi

121506.description:
Chi-Ho has been unlucky his whole life, but he was actually born with a rare, most auspicious destiny. It’s just that his mother, who is a shaman, decided to share his energies with seven girls in their neighborhood to help them overcome their cursed fates. But now that Chi-Ho has become an adult, it’s time for him to retrieve his energies. And the way to do that is… through touch?!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: タッチ・オン！〜触って封印解除〜

121513.description: Meet the city of absolute public order, Astraea. In it, the elite make sure there is a 99% yearly arrest rating, so it's no wonder it is often called the City of Justice. However for the remaining 1% there's Double Bullet, the team made up of 3 "lower ranked" individuals Kanako, Tamaru, and Barret.

Aru WIXOSS Shoshinsha ga Booster Pack wo Katte Deta Card Kara 4koma Manga wo Kaku 4koma Manga
A WIXOSS Beginner Has Bought a Booster Pack And Draws 4koma Manga

title.native: ウィクロス ぶくぶタマ劇場
ミッソンインパッセボーゥ

121518.description:
What would you do if you got yourself a big-breasted maid? This maid even has silvery hair and red eyes like a goddess. That sounds… kinda awesome… But… wait… wait a minute… how can my maid be the demon lord? That's not how this was suppose to go!? My dear Demon Lord, please change out of those clothes and I will take you home right away.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Picked Up a Demon Lord as a Maid

title.native: 異世界お好み焼きチェーン 大阪のオバチャン、美少女剣士に転生して、お好み焼き布教！
title.romaji: Isekai Okonomiyaki Chain: Osaka no Obachan, Bishoujo Kenshi ni Tensei shite, Okonomiyaki Fukyuu!

title.romaji: Konna Kuzu ga Arakawa-san ni Kokurou nante, Okogamashikute Dekimasen.

synonyms: 瑠璃の波風 沈黙の艦隊 海江田四郎青春譜

121525.description:
Shion has an idol childhood friend and a step sister from his dad’s 2nd marriage
For some reason, he lost his memories because he fell from the stairs, so the last thing he remembered was the night of june 6 when he was supposed to buy some crepe.
After getting out of the hospital, his childhood friend suddenly told him they are dating and that it’s a secret from his sister.
But, it turns out he’s also dating his sister!

121529.description:
What does your brain conjure up when you’re sleepless at night?

Winner of the winter Shikishou (Four Seasons Prize), magazine Afternoon's award for rookie authors.

121530.description:
The pilot chapter for the 19-volume Jiraishin series. Detective Iida and the unit try to save hostage lives when a 15-year-old boy takes over a bank.

This is the stand-alone pilot chapter for Jiraishin. This was published in the weekly magazine Morning Later, a different magazine from the series, and never collected into the volume release.

121533.description:
Angel Beth is dispatched to the earth to complete her mission to lead a lost human in the right direction. Her new assignment is to save Nick, who believes that his wife has betrayed him. Beth is doing her best to warm his ice-cold heart and heal the rift between him and his loved ones... but this is one tough mission!

(Source: Harlequin)

121534.description:
With grim determination, Bryn steps into the gallery Archangel. After graduating from an arts university, Bryn has barely managed to make a living because her paintings keep getting turned down one after another by the galleries she's approached. Even though this exhibition may be her last chance, she's tried to stay away from this particular gallery because it is the one where Bryn's father committed fraud five years ago. She had been in love with Gabriel, one of the gallery owners, yet he was the one who put her father in prison. Now she has changed her name, and she's sure no one will recognize her... How can her plan go wrong?

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

121535.description:
One year after her husband's death, Crys is still grieving when she agrees to visit her best friend's brother's house. When she gets there, she encounters Sam, a closed-off, guarded man. As Crys's stay continues, she feels more and more attached to Sam. But her enduring love of her late husband makes it difficult for her to accept the feelings that are taking hold of her heart...

(Source: Harlequin/SB Creative Corp.)

121537.description:
I'm Berlina Lacotte, 18 years old. I've reincarnated into a fantasy world while retaining the memories of my previous life. Though I'm now an orphan, I'm able to live a satisfiying life in the city making use of the memories of my previous life as well the special skill I was given. One day, I met my soulmate. One of those guys commonly known as, "the hero." The instant I picked him out from the crowd, I knew it was meant to be. This was my was soulmate. A romantic comedy where the heroine is the pursuer.

Note: Includes a side story.
synonyms: I Want to Become The Hero's Bride (￣∇￣)ゞ
I Wanted to Be the Hero's Wife (￣∇￣) ゞ

title.native: 勇者の嫁になりたくて(￣∇￣)ゞ
title.romaji: Yuusha no Yome ni Naritakute (￣∇￣) ゞ

title.native: 新上ってなンボ！！ 太一よ泣くな
title.romaji: Shin Agatte Nanbo!! Taichi yo Nakuna

121539.description:
Nozomi has married Shinji, an office worker in Tokyo, and is enjoying her newly-wed lifestyle. Until suddenly, Shinji's older brother runs off with his new family, forcing Nozomi to move into Shinji's family's home in the sticks! This is a cheerful manga about the struggles of mother and daughter-in-laws.

(Source: Media Do International/Beaglee)

121540.description:
Ikeda, a high school student, is a weird boy who believes in himself as a handsome guy...

Youth school drama spending time with Ikeda who makes you feel positive for some reason while being involved!!

121541.description: A fourteen year-old girl challenges the shogi competitive scene.

title.native: あそびの時間　暗黒遊戯昇天編
title.romaji: Asobi no Jikan: Ankoku Yuugi Shouten-hen

title.romaji: Kyoudai Seido no Aru Yankee Gakuen de, Kyou mo Chigiri wo Semararetemasu

title.native: 異世界王子の年上シンデレラ

121546.description: A historical manga set in the Sengoku period, about a beast-like wild boy raised by wolves.

121547.description:
"...! It's so tight even with just one finger in..." My kimono peeled off, he's sucking my nipples in a running coach... and that sensitive part of me is shivering from pleasure.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Note: Originally published as 36 chapters, the manga was later republished as 12 chapters.
