title.romaji: Shinshi, arui wa Moujuu: Fugou ni Ubawareta Otome no Junketsu

121548.description:
1. Mitsumeteitai (みつめていたい); Q vol.7
Sanae is a sweet and kind young schoolboy, although he gives the impression of being a troublemaker which leads to many problems. This side of Sanae causes the school doctor to worry about him. With his support, Sanae is slowly able to communicate well with the people around him. Without realising, Sanae develops feelings for the school doctor, who is getting married soon...... It's a student's monomaniacal fantasy.

2. Glass no Mukou ni (硝子の向こうに); Q vol.8
3. Lovely♥Love Song wo Kimi ni (ラブリー♥ラブソングを君に); Web BiQ 2012-05
4. Soshite Kare wa Kaze ni Natta (そして彼は風になった); BiQ vol.3
5. Hana ni Umorete (花に埋もれて); BiQ vol.1
6. Hana ni Umorete Epilogue (花に埋もれて エピローグ); kakioroshi

(Source: Renta!)

121550.description: One day, Hinako comes across a large piece of raw meat. That same day, her friend Maki has a strange dream. Is this real life or is it a dream? A story about friendship, youth and horror.

title.romaji: Kimi ga Niku ni Natte mo

121551.description:
Seiji Nono, a passionate Chinese cuisine chef who works at the food manufacturing corporation Yamato, looks like a punk, but he's actually a first-class cook. The contrast between his appearance and his cooking has earned him many fans. One day, when Nono meets the newly transferred elite, Takeru Misato, he invites him to come eat in his cafeteria, but Miasto coldly refuses him by saying he "dislikes oily Chinese food". With such strong personalities, there's love and arguments abound between this cool inspector and gangster chef couple!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: If I Hadn't Fallen in Love With You
title.native: 君と恋に落ちてなければ
title.romaji: Kimi to Koi ni Ochite Nakereba

121552.description:
Elite bureaucrat from the Ministry of Education Masato Saeki loves hunting for straight, inexperienced younger men. In the office, Masato works diligently while hiding his preferences. But, one day, he's asked to investigate a famous all-boys school. He's looking forward to being surrounded by so many young innocents! One night, he goes out and gets completely demolished by an unintelligent-looking playboy... Unable to forget the incredible sensations, he starts his job at the school and meets the student council president Kei Honjo. However, the sight of Kei's guarded demeanor and smile give him an odd feeling...

(Source: Renta!)

121553.description:
At work, his lack of emotion earned him the name "emotionless robot." Togo Shiranami is spending another day feeling zero self worth. He's on his way back from work when he sees a pervert in the park fountain. A little curious, he talks to the man who turns out to be a foreign prince, Sanarfam. The prince finds Togo's odd personality charming, and drags him back to his hotel. Once they start drinking, Togo starts loosening up and showing a very human side to himself. The prince claims that he will be the one to prove Togo's no machine...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Tender Love for an Emotionless Robot
title.native: とろける寵愛セルロイド

121554.description:
Isn’t this the kind of thing you’d do with a girlfriend? The ordinary and weak-minded Sakaguchi spent everyday with the talented cook and thoughtful ikemen Takato attached to him. The two roommates have a physical relationship that resulted from watching an AV together, and Takato’s sexual requests begin to escalate day by day. Nowadays they bathe together and kiss passionately like lovers. But one day, Takato went out to a mixer, and recently it seems as if he’s gotten a girlfriend. What are his intentions?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Notes:
Aho Ero was a web comic released on the author's home page. It was published in book format with retouched art and an extra chapter by Ichijinsha on November 15, 2016.
Contains an extra.

title.native: おおきい小竹とちいさい武田

121556.description:
When I woke up, I found myself having sex.

(Source: Hyeondaejineunggaebalsa, translated)

121557.description:
Xiao Zheng was forced into signing a marriage and employment contract after a one night stand with the female executive of New Arcana Group. During this time, he encountered many interesting female workers which he named them based on their unique characters…

Ice Goddess… Tyrannosaurus / Overlord Flower… Gentle Boss… Mischievous School Girl…

121558.description:
“I’ve never kissed anyone before… so help me out. Please?” Seo-Ha’s divorce is still fresh in her mind when 20-year-old Ji-Hoo begins working at her café. Ji-Hoo’s unassuming beauty immediately draws her in, and his desire for Seo-Ha burns too bright for her not to notice. Seo-Ha decides it wouldn’t hurt to shake him up a bit… but Ji-Hoo’s not the only one stepping into unfamiliar territory this summer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chaptes.
synonyms: 濡れた夏～年下男子と背徳に溺れる～

121559.description:
In the fantastical medieval land of Irok, magic is wielded by magicians and those wealthy enough to afford to purchase it. The merchant, Zio Oh and his young assistant, Bono sell magic scrolls but their success (and safety) are not guaranteed...

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.
synonyms: Jio le marchand de parchemins magiques

121560.description: In a small apartment within the magical city of Shanghai, by fate or coincidence, live six girls. Although they have different occupations, personalities, and even nationalities, they support and care for one another. What kind of hilarious, sweet, and heart-warming stories will happen between the three couples?

121561.description:
The seasons have changed and it will soon be the second spring. Tatsuya and Miyuki have finished their first year at First Magic High School and are on their spring break. The two go to their villa on the Ogasawara Island archipelago. After only a small moment of peace a lone young woman named Kokoa appears before them. She has abandoned the Naval base and she tells Tatsuya her one wish.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: The Irregular at Magic High School The Movie: The Girl Who Summons The Stars

title.native: 劇場版 魔法科高校の劣等生 星を呼ぶ少女
title.romaji: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Hoshi wo Yobu Shoujo

121563.description:
On her deathbed, a beloved grandma leaves behind a terrifying last wish: for her granddaughter to reunite with the horrible, no-good ex-husband that didn’t last even one year! Garyung instead vows to live alone forever, even if that means giving up her entire inheritance. But when a disastrous fire threatens to rob Garyung of her hard-earned fashion empire, she is forced to come to terms with the money, and the man, at stake. Where there is hate, is there also... love?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: セカンドラブは激しく

121564.description:
Even after fulfilling her dreams of becoming a magazine editor and living in Seoul, Go Su-A can't seem to shake the feeling that something is still missing. When a difficult day at work and an argument with her mother drives her to get a tattoo, Su-A bumps into the last person she expected to see: her first love, Baek Hu-Beom. This encounter rekindles old feelings and sparks questions about what happened between them nine years ago, but will Su-A be able to muster up the courage to ask them?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

121565.description:
Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter -- love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: WEBTOON)

121566.description:
27-year old Maki Enomoto is done with relationships. One year ago, her terrible boyfriend made her the joint guarantor on a loan before promptly ghosting her with a mountain of debt. Now she just wants to be left alone to her quiet otaku life, working her office job to make her ex’s monthly repayments, and devoting what scant little is left to her hobbies. Namely, her virtual boyfriend Allen-kun, who is hot, kind, and dependable in a way that real-life men aren’t—least of all the hotshot young VP that keeps getting on her case about deadlines and deliverables. But when said VP shows up with a rather interesting proposal, Maki must decide if she's ready to roll the dice one last time…

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: 副社長大人輕點寵 ~我的溺愛SSR老公~

title.native: 甘やかさないで副社長　～ダンナ様はＳＳＲ～
title.romaji: Amayakasanaide Fuku Shachou: Danna-sama wa SSR

121569.description:
Erin is a 27-year-old product director who's heard it all: hard-to-get, picky, impossible, too ambitious, and worst of all, too old to still be single. Unwilling to compromise for the sake of society’s standards, but desperate to break away from the endless cycle of blind dates her aunt imposes on her, she sets out with a hidden agenda for a contract boyfriend. With the right partner, it’ll be perfect—none of the emotions, drama, or responsibilities of a real relationship… or so she thinks!

(Source: Tapas)

121570.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

121571.description:
"Your body is lewd. But... you heart is like a maiden's?!"

Taiga has a scary face and is a slut, but his heart is like that of a young girl. An extreme romanticist and easily embarrassed, he never found a lover and only fulfilled his sexual desires with sex friends. One day, he saves Makoto, an incompetent father, and the two become close -- but then Makoto catches him having sex with one of his sex friends! Just when he thinks he'll be despised, it turns out that Makoto is extremely wild when it comes to sex and he seduces him instead...?!

title.native: ロマンティックビッチ

121572.description:
Kota is a university student who runs into bad luck wherever he goes. One day, the super-lucky Naoya saves Kota from getting hit by an oncoming car...and through some miscommunication, they start dating?!
It turns out Kota's bad luck gets better around Naoya, so if having to kiss him sometimes is all it takes for his bad luck to disappear, then that's not a bad deal at all! But Kota can't help but start to seriously fall for the naturally charismatic Naoya...

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Serialization originally ended on 2020-05-19 with one volume. Serialization resumed in 2022 to accompany the TV drama adaptation.
Includes five additional chapters.

title.english: Mr. Unlucky Has No Choice but to Kiss!
title.native: 不幸くんはキスするしかない！
title.romaji: Fukou-kun wa Kiss Suru Shika Nai!

121573.description:
I reincarnated as the wife of a cursed archduke in my own twisted novel. As the author, I took responsibility and set things right by lifting the curse, which was the key to returning home. I thought my job was done, and just when I was finally trying to go back, the archduke asked me, "Did you really think I wouldn't know that you’re planning on returning to your fiance?".

He had completely misunderstood!

"Whether you like it or not, I'm still your husband. I'm never letting you go back to that bastard."

All I want is for him to please let me go home!
synonyms: I Don’t Want the Obsession of a Twisted Archduke

title.native: 今日、アイツ（♂）にキュンとしてしまいました…!!
title.romaji: Kyou, Aitsu (♂) ni Kyunto Shite Shimaimashita...!!

121576.description: My life has been sold to two different people. Now I have to live as a different person in the day and night.

121577.description: A high school student, Inukai, had a heart for his friend, Misuzu Kamishiro, who had been separated when he was a child. One day, the Misuzu transfers to the Inukai class. With a nostalgia approaching Misuzu, Misuzu exclaims, "Don't bite me!" During the few years I didn't meet, Misuzu became "Saiko", an incompetent person who could hear the voice of the dead and understand. Appealing fantasy works by up-and-coming young artists!!

title.native: 恋する教師はお帰りください

121579.description: Note: Includes seven bonus chapters and seven side story chapters.

title.native: 疾風伝説 特攻の拓 外伝 〜Early Day's〜
title.romaji: Kaze Densetsu Bukkomi no Taku Gaiden: Early Day's

title.native: 不知火くんは何も知らない

121582.description:
Yusuke and Chizuru are known actors in the showbiz industry. To everyone else, they appear to be amicable work colleagues, but off cam, they are in a secret and complicated sexual relationship. While their relationship just sort of happened, Yusuke wants nothing but to monopolize Chizuru, but the latter is insistent on riling him up by seducing other people. At times, Yusuke finds something familiar about Chizuru here and there, and it seems Chizuru has his secrets and a plan he's been plotting for all this time.

(Source: Futekiya)

121583.description: Handsome, smart, but quiet and keeps to himself, Kanto Todo is the unattainable flower of the school. But actually, he's busy taking care of his twin siblings in addition to doing all the cooking and housework! His classmate Natsumi found out his secret domestic side and made fun of him for it, but she gradually realizes his gentle kindness. A short and sweet love comedy!

title.native: オカン系男子かなたん

synonyms: Asami-kun wa Gachi Koi ja Nai!

title.native: 麻実くんはガチ恋じゃない！

121587.description:
During an experiment at the South Pole, Iku and her father are caught up in the destruction wrought by a sudden mysterious earthquake. Meanwhile, as Ryo and his mother pray for their family’s safety, the quake’s aftermath triggers strange changes across the globe, resulting in an unprecedented flood. The warning bells of a modern-day apocalypse have begun to toll…!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

121588.description: Protagonist Kurumi Namihira, who always dreamed about working at Tokyo Dream Land, ends up getting a job at an amusement park far away in the countryside.

title.native: ふしぎの国の波平さん

121589.description:
Kusanagi Maki transferred to a middle school in the city due to family reasons. The cat eared ghost who appeared in front of her who couldn't fit into class was actually——!? A bittersweet oneshot delivered to you by Aika Yugiri, first time appearance in ASUKA!

(Source: Monthly Asuka, translated)

121590.description:
Literary greats from the past have been transmigrated to fight and protect their literature from beings called Taints that are trying to erase literary works. But among all the fighting, there are peaceful times too and many activities to do like enjoy a drink with friends, grow vegetables in the Imperial Library's courtyard or play some mahjong. What could go wrong when over 30 men, who either were good friends or rivals in the past, are now forced to live together and fight for the same cause...?

Bungou to Alchemist Comic Anthology series follows the daily life of transmigrated writers from the past in a slife of life, comedical style. The series references and amends content from the mobile and browser game Bungou to Alchemist.

title.native: 文豪とアルケミスト コミックアンソロジー

121594.description: Yuki Ono, seated between two attractive boys, found herself in a dilemma. Kiyokun and Yujikun, two boys at odds with each other, engaged in a mischievous battle during class, with Yuki caught in the middle! What was supposed to be a contest to determine superiority gradually evolves into a love triangle involving Yuki. Rubber bullets fly through the air! Close-quarter combat targeting lips! Don't fight over me! The chaotic trio's tomorrow is uncertain!

121595.description:
Videogames x Showa Culture x Glamour! A voluptuous and fascinating book for those that enjoy the Showa Era and playing video games! A large collection of stories, published in Harta by Benitsubaki's author, Takahashi Hirona, all in one volume!

Two glamorous folk tales, including "Glamorous-suteyama", a glamorous rearrangement of the Ubasuteyama legend! When a witch fostering a planet sprays it with some water, torrential rains begin to pour from above in "My first planet." "Shiramari" is a super idol whose singing voice makes people so happy they could die! And of course, the series of 16 shorts "It's okay to play games", the antithesis of being given a cold look while you're playing video games!

Full of bright, fantastical ideas, all these gems from Harta's new wave, Takahashi Hirona, in a single volume!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

121596.description:
Enter a world of mystery and alchemy in Mysterion.

Leon Schwarts is a simple sailor, enjoying his time at sea and his breaks on land, while doing his best to avoid sleeping and the nightmares that haunt him. During a trip to London, Leon's boat runs across what seems to be a deserted ship, only to find a single survivor, the beautiful girl Lapis. However, Lapis has secrets of her own that she is willing to go to extreme lengths to keep. This meeting starts a string of events that changes Leon's life forever...

(Source: Media Do International)

121597.description: Her name is Mari Shirase, the idol. What does it mean to aspire to be an idol? The profession that symbolizes dreams, the shining beacon of hope that transcends any era! An idol is the joyful messenger who delivers smiles and songs. This story is the complete chronicle of the legendary idol Mari Shirase's sparkling activities. It's a tale of blazing passion. There are no everyday scenes depicted in this manga. Every page is filled with the essence of singing, dancing, and idol activities.

121598.description:
Ro was abandoned in the wild by his father as soon as he was born. Luckily the Aesir god Loki took him in and raised him. After 13 years, Ro returns to his real home and the secrets around his birth are unraveled. This is the grand tale of the young viking Ro, set on the stage of Scandinavian mythology!

(Source: Media Do International/Beaglee)

title.native: プライベート・ストリッパー

121600.description:
Qian Xi, a teen boy, worked in a spooky museum displaying inconspicuous-looking collections, but it turns out each piece had a sad story behind it. A ball in a haunted cave, a weird butler robot, and the braised pork rice from a restaurant where a murder took place... How dark can humanity be? Come and hear out what these collections have to say.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes a prologue and two extra chapters.

title.native: 僕らは嘘に気づかない

121602.description:
Please, help me die!

Sick of living, Mimi has tried numerous times to take her own life. Much to her dismay, she somehow always ends up surviving. But then she comes across a website called "Death Candle" and ends up signing a contract with a demon of death: if Mimi helps him collect souls, he'll help her die.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: うつし世コンプレックス

title.english: Death Candle: The Hand of Death

121604.description:
A wedding for three

(Yiben Manhua, translated)

synonyms: 誰是最強鑑定士？～吃飽喝足的異世界生活～

title.native: 最強の鑑定士って誰のこと？ ～満腹ごはんで異世界生活～
title.romaji: Saikyou no Kanteishi tte Dare no Koto?: Manpuku Gohan de Isekai Seikatsu

121608.description:
1. Chionopolis (チオノポリス)
2. Untergang no Eiyuu (ンター・ガングの英雄)
3. Kouryuukai no Oshigoto (紅竜会のおしごと)
4. Sanzen Sekai no Karasu wa Shinanu (三千世界の鴉は死なぬ)
5. Shounen to Yuurei (少年と幽霊)
6. Warui Eiga de Ichido Shinda (悪い映画で一度死んだ)
7. HEATH's native HEATH
8. Shounen to Yuurei no Omoide (少年と幽霊の思い出)

title.native: 魔力融資が返済できない魔導師はぜったい絶対服従ですよ？　じゃあ、可愛がってくださいね？
title.romaji: Maryoku Yuushi ga Hensai Dekinai Madoushi wa Zettai Zettaifukujuu desu yo? ja, Kawaigatte Kudasai ne?

title.native: いせたべ～日本大好き異世界王女、求婚からの食べ歩き～
title.romaji: Isetabe: Nippon Daisuki Isekai Oujo, Kyuukon kara no Tabearuki

121611.description: Sumika, a high school girl living in a rural town, has the secret routine of "going into other people's homes." A complicated psychological mentality – despite knowing she is trespassing, she cannot stop. At the root of which, is discord between her mother, who insists on a minimalist lifestyle. A first-rate drama about humanity, woven by "homes" and "the people who live in them."
synonyms: 空き家に不法侵入する女子高生のお話
Akiya ni Fuhoushinyuu suru Joshikousei no Ohanashi

121612.description: A magician, a female doctor, a gangster, an archaeology professor, a policewoman, a drug dealer, a businessman... Such a random group of people find themselves trapped on a desolate island when they wake up from sleep one day. They are surrounded by primitive tribes, mutant viruses, and countless life and death situations on this mysterious island. What will they do to survive and escape?

synonyms: Baby, I'm crazy for your voice.

title.native: 声で魅せてよベイビー

121614.description:
Ariel is an angel, a being that exists to reward good deeds by granting small wishes that appear over people's heads. But one day, she encounters a girl whose wish neither she, nor any previous angel, could read. Aiming to grant Kirara's unknown wish, she descends upon the human world to meet her personally, but Kirara's mind isn't as innocent as her mountain of good deeds may suggest.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I'm an Elite Angel, But I'm Troubled By an Impregnable High School Girl

title.native: 私、エリート天使ですが難攻不落なJKに困ってます！
title.romaji: Watashi, Elite Tenshi desu ga Nankou Furaku na JK ni Komattemasu!

121615.description: Our protagonist, after failing the medical school exam, moves to a village to focus on his studies and become a great doctor like his grandfather, however, the place where he will stay is administered by three beautiful sisters who hide a great secret, besides the village itself and its people. Why are there only women!? Why does the youngest want to "eat" me? Why does she have... fangs!? What's going on in this place!?
synonyms: The Three Sisters Are Trying To Seduce Me!!
Hinoenma ga Ore wo Yuuwaku Shite Kuru!!

title.native: 三姉妹が俺をユウワクしてくる!!
title.romaji: Sanshimai ga Ore wo Yuuwaku Shite Kuru!!

121616.description: Wataru was picked up by a 100+ year old witch in a certain forest when he was a little boy. Some time later, he began to write about his daily life so that he would never forget those lovely days he spent with her and her cat Hotaru. When he began to have "special feelings" for the witch who raised him as a member of the family, he realised that one day he would surpass her age... A sad love story between a witch and a human that slowly passes through time.

title.native: 僕と魔女についての備忘録
title.romaji: Boku to Majo ni Tsuite no Bibouroku

121617.description:
Minami had longed to work in the city center and started a job at a food manufacturer. However, she has been assigned to a livestock farm in Hokkaido. Soon after her arrival, she encounters an escaped cow and faints. While being bewildered by things she's not used to, Minami is gradually inspired by her earnest coworkers. This is the story of a genuine livestock ranch.

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

121618.description:
Short stories all centering around farewells in life.

1. Sister's Departure
A boy has mixed feelings about his older sister moving out to live with her recently wed husband in Tokyo.

2. Pareidolia at Dawn
Hakushio is a succubus who resides in a forest. Hakushio is perplexed by Niwa, who has no heart and wants to know what love is.

3. Spring, a Storm, and a Curtain Call
Kaya and Shono are two girls in the theater club who are mulling over their future career paths.

4. Loop
A textless story showing footage of a young woman.

5-6. Nectar Afterglow
Fuji is a Nectarist, turning corpses into nectar for grieving families as a funeral ceremony.

7. Life of a Flower
A man becomes a famous painter even though he feels he is nothing special.
synonyms: Kyou, Totsugu Ane e: Sayonara no Shougai Series

121619.description:
Arakure Knight: Remember Tomorrow is the latest installment in Yoshida's Arakure Knight series. The manga franchise centers around delinquent Haruma Yūki, who seeks to join the motorcycle gang Linda. The manga shows the efforts of Haruma to join the gang, while also following the activities of Linda and its leader Zenba as they clash with rival motorcycle gangs.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: 荒くれナイト リメンバー・トゥモロー

title.native: 荒くれKNIGHT リメンバー・トゥモロー

121620.description:
Momoko is one of the brightest students at school, but the school is a bit overrun by delinquents from a motorcycle gang. In fact, the person who has the next desk has never come to class. Then one day she gets the upper hand on one of these bikers and they actually strike up a bit of a friendship, with the potential for more. Of course, it turns out that he’s the leader of the bike gang, and the student in the next seat who has been missing this entire year…

(Source: Animeraider)

title.native: ハイティーン・ブギ

synonyms: えろどう！　会長と俺と先輩の、同人&コスプレ生活！

title.native: えろどう! 〜会長と俺と先輩の、同人&コスプレ生活!〜
title.romaji: Erodou!: Kaichou to Ore to Senpai no, Doujin & Cosplay Seikatsu!

title.native: 俺と幼なじみの仲を妹が邪魔をする
title.romaji: Ore to Osananajimi no Naka wo Imouto ga Jama wo Suru

title.native: 俺と幼なじみと妹の仲を生徒会長が邪魔をする
title.romaji: Ore to Osananajimi to Imouto no Naka wo Seitokaichou ga Jama wo Suru

title.native: 創世の大工衆〈デミウルゴス〉
僕の知らないラブコメ

121627.description:
Who is he? Why is he called the Boss? Maybe he’s the fearless ruler of the world. Or maybe the worst enemy of humanity, who tears worlds down. After Su Sin was reborn, he lost all his skills and abilities from former life in a knights’ world. However, a newly implanted System can help him restore them. “My name is Su Sin where Sin means Promise keeper”.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

121631.description: After being abducted into the spirit world, a young boy awakens his powers of divinity by accessing nirvana. Together with his younger twin sister, they explore this mysterious world, study Taoism, get stronger, assist gods, make friends, solve mysteries, and become the number one demon-slaying god!
synonyms: Ascension to Godhood by Slaying Demons

121632.description:
Joo-Ahn and Do-Jin couldn’t be any more different at work. She's a perpetually single career woman who takes everything too seriously and rules with an iron fist. He's a modelesque klutz with a heart of gold who lucked into an entry-level marketing job.

But when a company trip to a mysterious temple starts an inexplicable soul swap, they end up switching bodies for an hour each day. To avoid utter embarrassment and keep up their reputations, the unlikely pair will have to cooperate and bide their time. Will Joo-Ahn learn to sympathize with the pretty boy who can’t do anything right? And will Do-Jin see the softer side of his boss’s spiky persona?

From the artist of hit rom-com 'What's Wrong with Secretary Kim" comes an all-new company couple about to spark some serious fireworks.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 1/24 สลับร่างรัก

121633.description:
I became the wife of a man who already had a lover.
So, I should do my best to help him remain faithful to her, right?

But how did I end up destroying the bed with him on our first night together...?

***

Aristine is a royal princess who's been confined all her life, as she is highly disfavored by the emperor.
But the truth is, as the possessor of the [Royal Sight], she can see the past, present, and future.

The emperor sends her off to die in a political marriage arranged with the prince of their enemy country, rumored to be a bloodthirsty savage, but...
Her soon-to-be husband, the so-called "savage," is far more normal than the rumors suggest.

"Still, he's taken, so he's off-limits for me. I'll just focus on making lots of money from now on!"

Will Aristine be able to fulfill her dream of living a luxurious, wealthy life?
Or will she be able to kill two birds with one stone and win over her husband as well?

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)
synonyms: Forget About My Husband, I'd Rather Go Make Money
I’m Done with My Husband, I’ll Go and Make Money
Forget My Husband, I'll Go Make Money

121634.description: Now that webtoon artist Ji Won is 31, she's starting to lose hope of ever finding love. As fate would have it, she meets her first love at work, but there's one problem...he doesn't seem to remember her! Does he really not remember her? Or is he just pretending?

121635.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.
synonyms: My Sister Picked Up the Male Lead

121636.description:
Myeong-In, a student at a third-rate university, doesn't get much support or respect at home. But his true identity is a professional online gamer who is famous and rich, a star gamer nicknamed "God of Game".

Suddenly, three beauties intrude into his double-identity life. And Myeong-In learns a shocking truth from them: the elites of society play something called "Game of Gods". If you win, you receive superhuman abilities and powers, and you can basically rule the real world!

121637.description:
His childhood friends are a set of twins, one who is doting and kind, and the other is stone-faced and awkward.

He is convinced the latter girl hates him... but she seems to be messing up her cues instead, and her intentions are not what he expected them to be...

title.native: 無愛想な双子の姉が、なぜか俺と仲の良い双子の妹のフリをしている話
title.romaji: Muaisou na Futago no Ane ga, Nazeka Ore to Naka no Yoi Futago no Imouto no Furi wo Shiteiru Hanashi

121638.description:
Liao Xi is a firm believer in the ideal perfect love. As a "Love Appraiser", she exposes men's lies for her clients. Is she safeguarding 'true love' or destroying it? Is she exposing lies or creating tragedies? Using lies to verify the truth— is the "truth" obtained this way real or fake?

Her world shifts when she meets the "perfect man" Bei and falls deeply in love. One of Bei’s close friends, Gong, a comic artist, happens to be one of her clients’ unfaithful partners and is deeply in love with 'Jiang Yifan', a character played by Liao Xi; and he makes Liao Xi question her beliefs about love.

Meanwhile, Bei’s rowdy friends— Xiu, Luan, and Sen— are also experiencing their own joys and struggles with love and marriage, wrestling with their beliefs about love.

(Source: Tapas)

121639.description:
Living for the sole aim of escaping! ‘Light of Rusbella’ was a depressing romance novel. Wishing for a new life, Asili Rosé was reborn as the 8th wife of the Estrian Emperor. She thought she was born with a golden spoon, but it was actually just a gilded spoon? Once she realized that nothing but ruin awaited, she found a diary foreshadowing the future...

It foretold Asili’s death by the hands of the Crown Prince, Castor!

[“What does the empire mean to you?”
After asking this, the Crown Prince smiled so very beautifully. And then he killed me.] Unfortunately, Asili kept coming back to life, and continued to be killed over and over again. As she continued to relive her deaths, she slowly lost her smile and changed.

…Let’s try to survive first.
----
“What can I do for my elder brother?”
“Well.”
----
Pale sky blue hair fluttered finely in the wind. He smiled weakly, before parting his dry lips.
“Call my name.”
“...”

My head quickly snapped up.
“Call me… Amoru.”
His fingertips skimmed along my inner wrist.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Don't Concern Yourself With That Book
Don't Give Your Heart to That Book

121641.description:
Noah prides herself in having many “more-than-friendship-but-less-than-love” type friends, but out of them Ji-Hoon Park is especially distant. So in her attempt to get closer to him, she gets drunk but accidentally gets physically friendlier instead. What a disaster. But, what's this? But after a drunken hookup, what's this? I'm loving his great body!!

(Source: Copin Comics)

121643.description:
It's tempting to tease the girl that you like, right? Nanase is interested in her classmate Momo. Whenever you see her, you can't help but to just play with her!

A yuri comedy about a girls school where the law is out of bounds and the girls are always on the edge of their seats! ☆

121644.description:
After getting bullied for months, Evelyn finally makes friends in school. Is this friendship or love? Find out what happens to the friends!

(Source: Toomics)

121646.description:
Manga adaptation of the TV drama and movie Spy no Tsuma.

Set in 1940, Yusaku (Issey Takahashi) runs a trading company in Kobe, Japan and he he is married to Satoko (Yu Aoi). While on a business trip in Manchuria, Yusaku learns of a horrific national secret. For the sake of justice, he decides to let the whole world know about his discovery. Satoko believes Yusaku, who is now accused of being a traitor. She swears to be with Yusaku no matter the consequences.

121647.description:
Following the death of her father, Tamaki leaves her village to attend high school in the capital. Although she had intended to live alone, when she’s offered a place at a stranger’s apartment after collapsing in the street, well...did she mention he’s pretty hot?!

(Source: Yen Press)

synonyms: Ore no Teni shita Isekai ga Kuso-game Nenkan Taishou

title.native: 俺の転移した異世界がクソゲー年間大賞
title.romaji: Ore no Teni shita Isekai ga Kusoge Nenkan Taishou

121650.description: "Galaxy Memories" is a group of 5 idols gathered by genius hackers that mysteriously changed jobs to be music producers. Their goal is to have a live show in space!

synonyms: Go Forth! Fantasy World Cheat Magician

title.native: それゆけ！異世界チート魔術師〈マジシャン〉
ツール・ド・ガールズ!!
アキバ戦記 異能力を封印した俺が、2.5次元の姫を護衛する
title.romaji: Akiba Senki: Inou Chikara wo Fuuin shita Ore ga, 2.5 Jigen no Hime wo Goei suru

title.native: JKが家にお泊まりしてくれるイチャラブアンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: JK ga Ie ni wo Tomari Shite Kureru Icharabu Anthology Comic

121674.description:
i-Mentor correctly lights the way 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Let's leave all life decisions to the "living pilot"—

In the near future, tablets called "i-Mentor" give accurate advice to people based on the latest genetic information. Will future dreams come true, is this person the best marriage partner? When will I die? All i-Mentors are based around numbers, and they teach you the "correct way of life." Is human happiness really determined only by "genes"?

In a "Utopia" managed by i-Mentor, everything is guided by data and numbers, and the dignity of human beings is tested.

(Source: Official Publisher, translated)

121680.description:
Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she’s about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father’s love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he’ll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father’s student.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Father, I Don't Want to Get Married!
Отец, я не хочу выходить замуж!
Daddy, I Don’t Want to Marry!

title.native: 아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!
title.romaji: Appa, Na I Gyeolhon An Hallaeyo!

121685.description: A high school teacher who only loved 2D girls, suddenly falls for one of his students who is also an anime enthusiast! Somehow, they end up living together and get engaged in a secret JK relationship!

title.native: おら、嫁っこさ行くだ！～コスプレJKの秘密の愛情～
title.romaji: Ora, Yomekko sa Iku da!: Cosplay JK no Himitsu no Aijou

121686.description:
Kiss x Pretty Girl = Valkyrie? For the sake of researching a human's 7th sense "Destruct Sense," I, Shindo Ichirou, enrolled in the newly opened school Epitaph. However, on the first day after school, I was attacked by a mysterious sword, and at a level that which could cut open the skies! At that moment, without understanding what was going on I was painfully saved.

The pretty girl wielding a rocket launcher, Rikudou Mari, said to me: "If you want to keep living, conjure up a Valkyrie!"

Armed battle fantasy beginning with a kiss, start!

title.native: キスから始まる戦機乙女〈ヴァルキュリア〉

121688.description: Kinu-san, a girl who's come to the Fujidana family as a bride, thinks of her husband as a man who lazes around everyday, but as she gets to know him she starts to think "My Husband has a bigger heart than I thought"
synonyms: Daily Life of a Certain Married Couple

121691.description:
A new manga announced commemorating the 10th anniversary of the Cardfight!! Vanguard franchise. Written by Itou Akira and drawn by Kageyama Naoyuki. It started serialization in Monthly Bushiroad from the 84th issue.

The story features 20 year old Toshiki Kai during his time in the European League along with Olivier Gaillard and Philippe Neve.

title.native: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード ターナバウト
クラスメイトのサードアイ

121694.description:
Note Athlon was really looking forward to becoming an adventurer with his best friend (and crush) Miya. That is, until he drew Mapping—a rare skill with practically no purpose. In other words, it’s trash. This kicks off a vicious spiral for Note, who plummets further and further into the depths of self-loathing despair when Miya leaves him. He now spends his days drinking away his earnings, wondering how things might have been different if only he’d pulled a better skill... But little does he know his trash-tier skill is about to score him an invite to a top-tier adventuring party! Note’s now determined to find his way through life—and a dungeon!—in order to make something of himself.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Mapping: The Trash-Tier Skill That Got Me Into a Top-Tier Party
title.native: 外れスキル【地図化】を手にした少年は最強パーティーとダンジョンに挑む
title.romaji: Hazure Skill [Mapping] wo Te ni Shita Shonen wa Saikyou Party to Dungeon ni Idomu

title.native: 陸奥圓明流異界伝 修羅の紋 ムツさんはチョー強い?!
title.romaji: Mutsu Enmei Ryuu Iikai-den: Shura no Mon - Mutsu-san wa Chou Tsuyoi?!

121698.description:
When I noticed, I was surrounded by a bunch of people wearing kimonos. When I looked into the river water, what was there was a young child… Eh, it’s me!?

The place where I washed ashore was a gaudy neighborhood, Yoshiwara. Huh? But it looks like the ones behind the lattice are men.

The ones who picked up the still young me from that strange place was an old man from a brothel called the『Amazuki Brothel』.

The place I was brought to was a men filled red light district. It seems that over here, men who had no choice but to become prostitutes were called Yuudan (male courtesan). Then I was given the name Nogiku and made to hide from the female customers and provide assistance.

For some reason I was also given courtesan training, but I’m not male!! I don’t want to learn how to seduce women!!

However, when I became 16 I looked at the handsome men who’d grown up with me as comrades and realized. This was the world of『Seeing a Dream Male Courtesan District ～A night spent together～』. I couldn’t even recall about myself but for some reason I remembered that I had played that game.

Nogiku was that otome game’s villain character. She got in the way of the protagonist’s love who sought to get closer to the men, and in the end she would even kill, she was a woman who wasn’t choosey of her methods. Because she was that type of woman she was given hellish punishment by the protagonist and co, but…

I don’t want thaaaaAAAt! I won’t interfere. I can only consider my fellows as older brothers, as something like comrades in arms!! I intend to help stealthily from the shadows.

title.native: 隅でいいです。構わないでくださいよ。
title.romaji: Sumi de Ii desu. Kamawanaide Kudasai yo.

121700.description:
A girl in a maid uniform came to Hitozu's house looking for a job. Her previous job was an assassin, and she is skilled in all the deadly arts, but she's a complete beginner at housework. Hitozu was confused by the strange request and sent her away. But then she saved Hitozu from a deadly accident, and he thought maybe they can make this work?

This is a story about a maid who was a cold-hearted killer learning about new emotions. A maid who lived a lonely life in the underworld finally finding family. The start of an enjoyable daily life.
synonyms: เมดสาวนักฆ่า

title.native: 巫女は清楚じゃないとダメですか？
title.romaji: Miko wa Seiso Janai to Dame Desu ka?

121703.description: A young boy is initially overjoyed at the news of him having an older sister, due to his father remarrying to a woman who has a daughter. That is, until he finds out that his new sister is actually his school's strict PE teacher, Shina. With his father going off to live with his new wife, the boy will live alone with his new sister. In their new life together, the boy finds out that Shina at home is completely different from Shina at work: clumsy, scared of insects, and kind.
synonyms: That Demonic Teacher Will Be My Sister?
Is that demon teacher my sister?
Ano oni kyoushi ga boku no ane ni narundesuka?

title.native: あの鬼教師が僕の姉になるんですか？
title.romaji: Ano Oni Kyoushi ga Boku no Ane ni Narun desu ka?

121704.description: Our hero, “Matsushiro Kota,” is an ordinary salaryman brought to a world similar to medieval period Europe! This world does contain empires that propagate evil to destroy humanity; this is not a story about that which disturbs the laws of the universe, but about a peaceful place in the “Orukena continent,” plagued with a problem bigger than anything else…… deficit government bonds! A tr*shed economy!!! Crashing stock prices, the storm of debt defaulters occurring with the currency collapse, the failure of derivatives, conservative mainstream of the Senate, elder statesmen, who, with cunning and harassment, further the state of famine and war. It’s a time where the sword cannot aid in solving problems, but for the inherent wisdom and courage to rise above all ……You are now witnessing history in making.
synonyms: The Annals of the Flame Kingdom
นายแบงค์คู่คิด กู้พิษเศรษฐกิจต่างมิติ

121706.description: A special manga to be published in the 34th volume of Weekly Shonen Magazine in celebration of the fifth anniversary of Fate/Grand Order.
synonyms: Scathach, Queen of the Land of Shadows: The Unknown Story

121708.description:
Late at night in the middle of my part time job at a convenience store, I had an encounter with a robber and was mercilessly stabbed to death.

As I was about to lose my consciousness, I thought about how much I wanted to do this and that when I heard a voice……

『The wish to be summoned has been confirmed. Granting Unique Skill 《Jack of all Trades, Master of None》』

Rude words such as that were said. Jack of All Trades, Master of None? Don’t screw with me!

Such thoughts and wishes were for naught as my consciousness faded, when I came too I was standing on a green foggy hill.
synonyms: I Came to Another World as a Jack of All Trades and a Master of None to Journey while Relying on Quickness

A cute and cuddly story between a big gentle dog and two naughty little kittens.

121728.description:
They may not show it, but you'll feel it!

Being hit by a car would be a terrible accident for most, but one lucky guy just hit the jackpot! After finding out the car was owned by a wealthy company, the mega-corp lends him one of their own personal maids, the expressionless but graceful Toori, to take care of his battered body.

Using her pouty lips, slender hands, and soft curves, Toori does everything her master asks of her to satisfy him. As she edges him close to climax, he asks Toori to take charge and her body language changes. The thought of being in charge is intoxicating and a maid always obeys her master, even if it's too much for him to handle!

I'm Rather… Fond of You. by Hishigata Tomaru excels at sweet, passionate beauties who are just as erotic as they look. Playful and big-hearted, these women love to embrace their lovers and smother them in their massive mounds. Packing ten thick chapters, readers will go from fondness to pure love in zero seconds flat!

(Source: Fakku)

A man with such an esteemed noble pedigree and beautiful looks – really, someone like this shouldn’t be interested in me. That sort of couples’ sugary sweet, mushy talk… Please, I’m begging you! Start this sensual love affair with someone else!

121730.description:
A girl ran into Kazuki Takaki's room, pulled out a funny-looking stick, and shouted, "henshin-tsu~☆"— In that moment, the girl's figure became wrapped in light in front of Kazuki's eyes, her silhouette stark-naked, and became a figure that can only be described as"magical girl"... and so, Kazuki's absurd days begin! In the heart of this town that will soon be covered in a mysterious barrier, what is the choice that Kazuki will make?!

(Source: Official Publisher, translated)

Coming from the future, David Ernst will rise in fame with his comrades as a Hero of the Confederation. Searching for the right answer between Self-determinism and Socialism, to lead his country toward the right future.

121736.description:
Mio Karino, who works as a secretary, hides the fact that he is an omega under the young master, Nagao Keisei, who dislikes omegas. Although he was embarrassed by Keisei, who does not believe in people, Keisei also devotes his heart to Karino. However, he was told that Karino was an omega, and he ordered him to leave. There is a circumstance where he cannot return, and he uses drugs to forcefully return to Keisei!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

121737.description: Mimibukuro-san is self conscious of herself, and can't really talk to anyone. It's up to Makoto-kun to help her out and make friends with each other. However, that's not the end of it. There is someone trying to disrupt the two. Will they succeed, or will they join in...

121741.description:
After a messy breakup, college freshman Yoh Yagisawa returns home only to find she has an unexpected male roommate! Introducing himself as her old childhood friend who moved abroad, handsome Haruma Hirose is back to do a homestay. He's totally hot, super nice, and always there when Yoh's in trouble... but could Haruma's timing be a little too perfect? Plus, the house next door, where he claims to have lived-didn't the family there all commit suicide...?

(Source: Yen Press)

121743.description:
Even though you like my older sister, the person Senpai will be going out with is me!
His confession to his classmate, Ayahi, the girl he yearns for was a massive failure and it's all her little sister, Azuki's fault, because she interferred!
"I'm sorry, Senpai. As an apology, how about i let you do all the things you wanted to do with my older sister, with me instead?"
Just like that, Azuki started teasing me more and more...

(Source: Fantasiabunko, translated)

121746.description: Hanatsu Kaburagi is the public morals committee chairman, president of the archery club, has excellent scores, and is the daughter of a rich family. But there's one thing nobody ought to know about her: she's hopelessly perverted. Follow her and her boyfriend through her final school terms and see how she manages her two opposing personalities. And what is it with the donuts?

121747.description:
My male best friend is now.. a girl?
Taeju and Haewon were best friends growing up. One day, Taeju moves to the United States. Years go by without any contact, until Taeju suddenly comes back to Korea in search of his best friend. But what happens when his male best friend is now a high school … girl?!

(Source: Manta)

121748.description: Lyra is a girl who attends a magical school and has a huge amount of magic but can't use it. One day, she finds a picture book at the Great Magic Library.

121749.description: Based off of the Japanese PSP game, Photo Kano, this adaptation focuses on the characters, Sanehara Hikari and Masaki Nonoka, in volumes 1 and 2 respectively.

121751.description:
Half a year after moving to Kyoto, high school girl Aoi Mashiro brings her late grandfather’s old scrolls to Kura, an antique store nestled in Kyoto’s Teramachi-Sanjo shopping arcade, for an appraisal. One thing leads to another, and she winds up working there part-time. The manager’s son, Kiyotaka Yagashira—nicknamed the “Holmes of Kyoto”—is uncannily perceptive, and together, they solve strange cases relating to the antiques brought to them by clients.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

It’s brains over brawn in this new isekai adventure! One day when leaving work, a salaryman dies and is reborn in another world as the weak child of the noble Louvent family. Using his “appraisal” skill, which lets him see the stats of others, young Ars Louvent recruits the best people to his side in order to turn his country around.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Alucard, known by “Al” for short, is a vampire who has been raised by a priest, You. Providing Al the fluids he needs to survive has created an unusually close relationship between the two, but what will become of their partnership as You’s mortality catches up to him?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: プラチナ・ブラッド

121758.description:
The night of his brother's funeral, Kasuka Tokio interrupts a young man in the act of stealing his brother Hajime's ashes. The man, Kuroki Ren, claims to have promised to go on a trip with Hajime, and asked for his bones so that he could take them on the trip instead. Tokio, intrigued by him, agrees to lend a bone to him, under one condition...

(Source: Printemps Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

121761.description: The yakuza head Kohaku was shot while attempting to save a cat, but instead of dying, he was summoned into a different world. But how did he end up as the priestess of the animal-eared and tailed Cat ear clan?!

title.native: 異世界ヤクザのモフモフ滞在記

121762.description:
Mercenary adventurer Theo Aspel is tragically weak, leaving him no choice but to repeatedly joins various parties—only to get kicked out. In order to get stronger, he succeeds at summoning a demon that will grant him a wish. But the minute he sees her, his wish to get stronger flies straight out the window.

This devil, who hadn’t been summoned in many years declares: "I will grant your wish, but you must give me something precious to you." Theo stutters out a reply: “W—will you marry me?” The devil is stunned to say the least, but grants his wish, making them husband and wife. They embark on a happy married life together, causing quite a stir around them along the way. This is a story of a boy and a girl that's a just a tiny smidge dirty.

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.
synonyms: I Summoned the Devil to Grant Me a Wish, but I Married Her Instead Since She Was Adorable ~My New Devil Wife~
為了實現願望召喚了惡魔，但因為太可愛就結婚了　～惡魔的新妻～

121763.description:
When Su Xiaobai is dying from an illness, he accidentally comes to another world with the remaining soul of Long Ming, Star King, the strongest human in this world, in his body. He gains the strongest ability called "Infinity of Darkness" at the price of feeling terrible pain whenever he gets an erection. Only when he finds out the person who plotted Long Ming's death and succeeds to the throne can the pain disappear...

(Source: WeComics)

121764.description:
One day, the future is captured by a camera picked up by accident?!

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

121765.description: Kyohei Saito, a first-year college student who's gloomy and negative—in other words, "depressing"—falls in love with Ayame Ogawa, a beauty and contestant of their school's beauty pageant. Will the depressing nobody's feelings reach the goddess who basks in the spotlight? The curtain rises on an ensemble cast drama of college students shaken by the glimmer and helplessness of youth!

121766.description:
Tatara Tani is so average it hurts—the only thing he has going for him is that his childhood friends are ultra-popular idol Yuriko Hanazono and her fashionable twin, Ranko Hanazono! They're both his classmates, and his long-standing relationship with them makes others seethe. So he thinks he's hit the jackpot when Yuriko asks him to the amusement park with her, even though idols aren't allowed to date. She dresses up as Ranko to fool the world, but when her ruse is discovered by the school, it's up to the REAL Ranko to save her sister's reputation...by dating Tatara herself? This crazy rom-com of errors begins!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: วุ่นนักรักแฝด บ้านฮานาโซโนะ

title.native: 花園さんちのふたごちゃん

121767.description:
Masato's cousin Yuusei used to be so cute... but now that he's all grown up, he's naughty, ridiculously handsome, and won't take no for an answer! Masato's younger cousin has just started college, and he's going to be lodging with Masato's family until he graduates. Things are already off to an awkward start when Masato accidentally witnesses Yuusei getting rejected by his little sister, Saki. What's more, Masato's frantic efforts to console his cousin are rewarded with... Yuusei running his fingers over his body! Wait. Was Masato his target all along!? He'd always thought of Yuusei as a cute little brother. How will he respond to his, er, adult advances!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 年下イトコは強淫王子

121768.description:
Every day I cherished, the time I was with you...

This work was selected by the 2013 Manga Scout.

(Source: Naver)

121769.description:
Kentaro still dreams of his childhood friend Haru, who gave him some handjobs as Kentaro pretended to sleep at the last night before he left home for university.

Two years later, Haru comes after Kentaro for studying at the same university, but because they never talked about what happened, Kentaro feels very uneasy and wants to avoid Haru. Easier said than done, since Haru moves in right next door and even joins the same club activities.

Will they overcome their brotherly childhood relationship and be able to become real lovers?

title.native: やましい恋のはじめかた

121771.description: Tsukasa has trouble talking to boys her same age, even though she can talk to her dad, grandpa, and other men in the neighborhood. But when her family's struggling inn decides to take on boarders, two upperclassmen from Tsukasa's high school move in. Matsuoka Ren dislike girls because they crowd and fuss over him due to his handsome appearance. Ryohei Miwa is a charmer who says he likes everyone, boy or girl. A story of youth and growth among three people entangled by love.

121772.description: Kanon and Nana work at a busy IT firm in different departments. It's a well known fact in the company that the two never get along and are constantly bickering at work. Tired of having to hear them fight again, their coworkers lock them up and leave them in a meeting room alone together...

121773.description:
Modern-day Daoist Fang Yi wakes up one day with a superpower—the ability to sense antiques and artifacts! From there, he becomes an artifact-collecting wonder. Countless treasures all become his, and he leads his band of brothers on a journey to the very peak of life!

(Source: Webnovel)

121774.description: A quaint little bar awaits its destined clients… Meanwhile, the strange bartender with a glass of cocktail reveals the mysteries of your life by looking into your past reincarnations — containing stories of love and hate throughout the centuries. Come and explore the brotherly bond between a dragon bartender and demon hunter. A touching story that even dazzles the heavens with its world of monsters; a world where a dragon searches for traces of his demon hunter friend from his past life, longing to meet again. But how did the talented demon hunter and mysterious dragon meet?

121775.description:
It’s 1935 in Gyeongseong, and struggling artist I-Ho Yun has been commissioned by the reclusive, elderly Madam Jeong-Hwa Song to paint a portrait. Madam Jeong-Hwa Song allows I-Ho to set eyes upon her -- an unprecedented event -- and standing before him is a young woman. But why does she ask him to paint an elderly version of her? “Don’t finish the portrait.” Tucked between the previous artist’s paint tubes is an ominous letter. I-Ho learns that no artist has left Madam Song’s abode alive or of sound mind. Just what is she hiding and what will happen if I-Ho finishes the portrait?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: ปริศนามาดามซง

121777.description:
“The police are going mad!”

Crazy things are happening throughout the city—a Saiyan is suddenly holding his girlfriend hostage, a missing wife has turned into a happy woman and the reason for all this is… The "Ultimate Love Bazaar" that claims they can solve any love-related problems?!! And the one selling all these love problem-solving items is a very crafty witch that can go through different dimensions?! A cold-faced and serious policeman was just doing his job and… This charming love hotpot is boiling; would you like to have a taste, dear customer?

(Source: Comikey, edited)

121779.description:
When a northern goose meets a southern sparrow.

"Mr. Duck, are you from the north?"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Nanfang De Niao He Beifang De Niao

121783.description: On a mountain formed by trash carelessly thrown away by the people below, a young girl adept with repairing almost anything discovers an ambulance. Not only an ambulance, but there's someone inside... missing an arm? Who is this mysterious person? Why are they there and who threw them away? Find out in this one-shot, Kuzukago Mountain!

121784.description: A girl is afraid of confessing her feelings to the boy she likes until she finds a book called "Love Practice" in a mysterious shop. Using the book, the girl creates a confession look-alike in order to practice love...

121785.description: My first ever love disappeared 13 years ago... and came back as a vampire.

title.native: となりのフィギュア原型師

121787.description:
Suffering from auditory hallucinations, he, known as a cold president, could always hear the thoughts of the people around him. There was one time when he accidentally heard female lead singing, it seems as though the noisy voices in his head were gone. When he heard her sing, he instantly turned into a sweet boy... A hilarious and warming story now starts!

(Source: Webcomics App)

121788.description:
On that night he was driven out to the street, Ritsuya met his eternal admiration, Mayato. It was just a short meeting, but these two boys in pain finally found the best comfort on each other, sealing their bond for the years after. But, how would they survive in the world of irresponsible adults? "Matching our Answers" is a modern BL with a taste of classic unfortunate children folk tales that resolves on the idea of love and pain...

(Source: MANGA.CLUB)

121789.description:
In an era where people no longer believe, this will be the gods' final legend.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

title.native: 精密機械とてきとー人間
title.romaji: Seimitsu Kikai to Teki to Ningen

121791.description: One day, while Yukino is stuck because her scarf can't be fixed with her broken hand, a senior with a good smell helps her. From that moment on, Yukino wants to know everything she can about that senior, though she is unable to answer the question of "why" that knowledge is so important to her, or why her heart can't stop beating when she's around her.

121792.description: The end of the world is coming, terror covers the whole world, and the earth becomes a hunting ground for zombies and mutants. Zhao Tianlei accidentally obtained a mysterious super system. Although he is not a saint, but seeing the tragic situation in the world and the death of his classmates, how can he stand by and look at how Zhao Tianlei, who has a super upgrade and exchange system, leads humans Fight against corpses, restore human civilization?
synonyms: ゴッドシステム～終末の救世主～

121794.description:
Hari is your average quiet girl who got assigned the bubbly Yeonju as a roommate, and somehow they became best friends. But just before Hari can tell her about her crush on a charming senior named Jinho, Yeonju says it first—and that they’re dating! After years of watching from the sidelines, Hari finally gets over him, but now he’s chasing after her... With no time for romance, Hari agrees to a blind date to get rid of Jinho. Who knew her blind date had an unrequited love of his own?

(Source: Tapas)

121795.description:
Being popular isn’t easy. It’s hard to beat Saku Chitose. The most popular kid in his high school? Check. An ironclad reputation that can weather even vicious online attacks? Check. A group of friends as attractive on the outside as they are inside? Check. But when a teacher asks for his help bringing back a student who has been shut away in his room for months, Saku’s perfect world will never be the same. What is this, some kind of normie harem story...?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: The series won the Award of Excellence in the 13th installment of the Shogakukan Light Novel Award in 2018 under the title "Ramune no Bin ni Shizunda Biidama no Tsuki" (ラムネの瓶に沈んだビー玉の月). It was later renamed to "Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka" for the official publication.

After meeting on the train home, a student agrees to cook weekly for a lonely salaryman, starving for both homecooked meals and affection.

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

121800.description:
Coutad, the servant of the strongest party, was told to take a break. Coutad, who can't put a damper on the performance of the party, which boasts 100% success rate, decided to leave to carry out the mission of relaxing at a hot spring inn for a month. But the unconscious fighting and office-cheat workaholic acts no different, even when he's on vacation--!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

121801.description:
Caught in the clutches of an abusive relationship, Soo-In longs to escape. A vampire who finds human blood repulsive, Chi-Hwan only drinks the blood of other vampires. When chance brings the two together, Chi-Hwan makes Soo-In an enticing proposal. Chi-Hwan will help Soo-In get out of his living hell and in exchange... Soo-In has to let Chi-Hwan drink his blood. Will this proposal change both their lives for the better?

Note: The chapter count includes 19 extras.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

121803.description:
When the club door is opened after school, the four cats have been awaiting for them! The stray calico cat who absolutely adores his owner, Miisuke. The tsundere cat who acts like a queen, Maria. The cowardly little kitten, Sasuke. The chubby mafia boss-like cat, Oyabin. The four cats have been kept well, pampered, and adored... in the Mitsuhashi High School Cat Club!

(Source: Japanese publisher, translated)

When faced with the struggles and trials of life, Hilnama turns to what she knows: writing and creating manga! In year 29 of the Divine Era, more than thirty years have passed since a mysterious monster from the heavens destroyed all of Japan except Shikoku. Young boys and girls, already unaware of the tragedy of that time, live in peace behind the wall that protect Shikoku. In such a time, there was a girl who was given the name "Yuuna" because of a special gesture she made at birth. Yuuna is an honorary name taken from Takashima Yuuna who perished in a fierce battle with the monsters about 30 years ago. Yuzuki Yuuna was one of those Yuunas, but contrary to her heroic name, she was a girl with no special powers. She learns that there is a girl in the same school with the same Yuuna name. So, when she has the opportunity to take her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to Emperor Kael Lu Kaldorf, Lilian jumps at the chance. The only problem is, her prospective partner gets cranky without his sleep, and since being cursed by a vindictive witch, the tyrannical emperor hasn’t experienced a single moment of slumber. But that’s no challenge for Lilian, who possesses the ability to induce sleep with a kiss. Now, tasked with the duty of keeping His Majesty well-rested, Lilian must kiss the emperor each night to keep his temper at bay. It’s a simple contractual agreement, and Lilian has no plans to develop romantic feelings, but what happens when Kael unexpectedly falls for her?

Broken-hearted, Natsuro is sitting in a park he once frequented with his former love when a man approaches him, reminding him of the one he'd just lost. His name is Tsuyuhiko. Tsuyuhiko practically forces Natsuro to come to his apartment,saying he can't bear to leave a man drowning in his sorrow. Then,exchanging few words, Tsuyuhiko says Natsuro can think of him as a replacement for his former love as they indulge themselves in pleasure. Natsuro can't believe what he's done. But, seeing Tsuyuhiko's innocent smile as he promises to see him again,something starts to change inside him. Little does he know the complicated issues that plague Tsuyuhiko. In the depths of despair, he meets Tao, a younger, arrogant gay man who runs a share-house. "If you pretend to be my lover, I'll take you in?" Tsusaka, who is trying to reclaim his elite life and is willing to swallow his pride and ask Tao for business know-how, ends up accepting Tao's outrageous condition!?

121868.description:
Soyou, who was a promising track and field athlete, lost everything due to acute heart disease. She was sentenced to death but miraculously survives with a heart donation. She loses everything she had built up and returns to high school a year later than her peers, but it is not easy for her to make friends or pursue her dreams. Then, in the new semester of the second year, the moment she sees a boy in the classroom, her heart suddenly races, and she feels like crying... The man she met in her dream that night introduces himself as the owner of the transplanted heart and the father of the boy she saw for the first time today. Isn't that something? His son, Jaeha, has lost his entire family and is alone in this world... At the man's request, Soyou gives Jaeha a message of support, and with each action, precious people are found in Soyou's empty life—reasons for life, relationships, and dreams. Soyou progresses slowly, but one by one, she learns how to live.

Missing my parents, Woo-Joo cried until he fell asleep, and when I opened my eyes, I found myself in the past 23 years ago, before I was even born. Woo-Joo was faced with the other side of his parents, whom he thought were affectionate, and the truth about his brother who had no choice but to become a murderer. Woo-Joo struggles in the face of cold, merciless violence and tries to change the past, but humans do not change so easily. Can Woo-Joo stop the violence of the past and save his parents? The only clue of Seju's identity is a mysterious note that appears in her pocket each day. Sul-Bi sticks with her, determined to help and solve the mystery that is Seju.
